a: Gemara tanya, rabbi yose haggelili omer: vechi mippene sheachal ze tartemar basar veshata chatzi log yayin haitalki amra tora yetze levet din lissakel? ella higgia tora lesof dato shel ben sorer umore, shessof megammer nichse aviv umevakkesh limmudo veeno motze, veyotze lefarashat derachim umelastem et habberiyyot.

Amra tora: yamut zakkay veal yamut chayyayv, shemmitatan shel reshaim – hanaa lahem vahanaa laolam, velatztzaddikim – ra lahem vera laolam. shena veyayin larshaim – hanaa lahem vahanaa laolam, latztzaddikim – ra lahem vera laolam. sheket larshaim – ra lahem vera laolam, velatztzaddikim – hanaa lahem vahanaa laolam. pizzur larshaim – hanaa lahem vahanaa laolam, velatztzaddikim – ra lahem vera laolam.
Mishna habba bammachteret niddon al shem sofo. haya ba bammachteret veshavar et hechavit, im yesh lo damim – chayyayv, im en lo damim – patur.

Gemara amar rava: may tama demachteret? chazaka en adam maamid atzmo al mamono, vehay memar amar: i azelna, kae leappay vela shavek li, vei kae leappay – katelna leh. vehattora amra: im ba lehorgecha – hashekem lehorgo.
Amar rav: habba bammachteret venatal kelim veyatza – patur. may tama? bedamim kenanhu. amar rava: mistabbera milleteh derav besheshshibber, deletanhu, aval natal – la.
Vehaelohim! amar rav: afillu natal – deha yesh lo damim veneensu, chayyayv. alma birshuteh kayymi. hacha name, birshuteh kayymi.
Vela hi, ki okminhu rachamana birshuteh leinyan onasin, aval leinyan mikna – birshuteh demarayyhu kayymi, midde dehave ashshoel.
Tenan: ba bammachteret veshibber et hechavit, yesh lo damim – chayyayv, en lo damim – patur. tama deshibber, dechi en lo damim patur. ha natal – la.
Hu haddin daafillu natal name, veha deka tane "shavar et hechavit", ka mashma lan dechi yesh lo damim, af al gav deshibber name – chayyayv.
Peshita, mazzik hu! ha ka mashma lan daafillu shello bechavvavna. may ka mashma lan? adam muad leolam? tenena: adam muad leolam, ben beshogeg ben bemezid, ben beones ben beratzon! kashya.
Metiv rav bivi bar abbaye: haggonev kis beshabbat – chayyayv, shehare nitchayyev bigneva kodem sheyyavo lide issur shabbat.
Haya megarer veyotze – patur, shehare issur geneva veissur sekila bain keechad.
Vehilcheta: dishdanhu benahara.
Rava iggenavu leh dichre bemachtarta. ahderinhu nihaleh, vela kabbelinhu. amar: hoil unefak mippummeh derav.
Tanu rabbanan: "en lo damim. im zarcha hashshemesh alav". vechi hashshemesh alav bilvad zarcha? ella, im barur lecha haddavar kashshemesh sheen lo shalom immecha – horgehu, veim lav – al tahregehu.

Tanya iddach: "im zarcha hashshemesh alav damim lo". vechi hashshemesh alav bilvad zarcha? ella, im barur lecha kashshemesh sheyyesh lo shalom immecha – al tahargehu, veim lav – horgehu. kashya setama assetama!
La kashya,
b: Kan – beav al habben, kan – beven al haav.

Amar rav: kol deate alay bemachtarta – katelna leh, levar merav chanina bar shela. may tama? illema mishshum detzaddik hu – ha kaate bemachtarta! ella mishshum dekim li begavvevy dimrachem alay kerachem av al habben.
Tanu rabbanan: "damim lo" – ben bachol ben bashshabbat, "en lo damim" – ben bachol ben bashshabbat.

Bishlama "en lo damim" ben bachol ben bashshabbat itzterich, salka datach amena: midde dehave aharuge bet din, divshabbat la katlinan. ka mashma lan dekatlinan. ella "damim lo" ben bachol ben bashshabbat? hasheta bachol la katlinan leh, bashshabbat mibbaya?
Amar rav sheshet: la nitzrecha ella lefakkeach alav et haggal.

Tanu rabbanan: "vehukka" – bechol adam, "vamet" – bechol mita sheatta yachol lahamito. bishlama "vehukka" bechol adam itzterich, salka datach amena: baal habbayit hu dekim leho, deen adam maamid atzmo al mamono, aval acher – la.
Ka mashma lan, derodef hu, vaafillu acher name. ella "vamet" bechol mita sheatta yachol lahamito, lema li?

Merotzeach nafka, detanya: "mot yumat hammakke rotzeach hu" – en li ella bemita haamura bo. uminnayin sheim i atta yachol lahamito bemita hakketuva bo, sheatta rashshay lahamito bechol mita sheatta yachol lahamito? talmud lomar: "mot yumat" – mikkol makom.
Shane hatam, deamar kera: "mot yumat".
Venigmar minneh? mishshum dehave rotzeach vegoel haddam shene chetuvin habbain keechad, vechol shene chetuvin habbain keechad en melammedin.

Tanu rabbanan: "machteret" – en li ella machteret. gaggo, chatzero vekarpefo minnayin? talmud lomar: "yimmatze haggannav" – mikkol makom. im ken, ma talmud lomar "machteret"? mippene sherov gannavim metzuyin bammachteret.

Tanya iddach: "machteret" – en li ella machteret. gaggo, chatzero vekarpefo minnayin? talmud lomar: "yimmatze haggannav" – mikkol makom. im ken, ma talmud lomar "machteret"? machtarto zo hi hateraato.
Amar rav huna: katan harodef, nittan lehatztzilo benafsho. kasavar, rodef eno tzarich hateraa, la shena gadol vela shena katan.
Etiveh rav chisda lerav huna: yatza rosho – en nogin bo, lefi sheen dochin nefesh mippene nefesh. veammay? rodef hu! shane hatam, demishshemayya ka radfi la.

Nema mesayyay leh: rodef shehaya rodef achar chavero lehorgo, omrin lo: ree sheyyisrael hu uven berit hu, vehattora amra "shofech dam haadam baadam damo yishshafech". amra tora: hatztzel damo shel ze bedamo shel ze.
Hahi rabbi yose berabbi yehuda hi, detanya: rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer, chaver en tzarich hateraa, lefi shello nittena hateraa ella lehavechin ben shogeg lemezid.

Ta shema: rodef shehaya rodef achar chavero lehorgo, omrin lo: ree sheyyisrael hu uven berit hu, vehattora amra "shofech dam haadam baadam damo yishshafech". im amar: yodea ani shehu ken – patur. al menat ken ani ose – chayyayv.
La tzericha, dekae bitre ivre denahra, dela matze atztzole. may ikka? devae etoye leve dina. be dina bae hateraa.
Ibbaet ema: amar lecha rav huna, ana daamari ketanna demachteret, deamar: machtarto zo hi hateraato.

a: Mishna veellu hen shemmatztzilin otan benafshan: harodef achar chavero lehorgo, veachar hazzachar, veachar hannaara hameorasa. aval harodef achar behema, vehamechallel et hashshabbat, veoved avoda zara – en matztzilin otan benafshan.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: minnayin lerodef achar chavero lehorgo shennittan lehatztzilo benafsho? talmud lomar: "lo taamod al dam reecha". veha lehachi hu daata? hay mibbee leh lechidtanya: minnayin laroe et chavero shehu tovea bannahar, o chayya gorarto, o listin bain alav, shehu chayyayv lehatztzilo? talmud lomar: "lo taamod al dam reecha". in, hachi name.

Veella, nittan lehatztzilo benafsho menalan? atya bekal vachomer minnaara hameorasa: ma naara hameorasa shello ba ella lefogmah, amra tora nittan lehatztzilah benafsho, rodef achar chavero lehorgo – al achat kamma vechamma.
Vechi onshin min haddin? deve rabbi tana, hekkesha hu: "ki kaasher yakum ish al reehu uretzacho nefesh". vechi ma lamadnu merotzeach?
Meatta hare ze ba lelammed venimtza lamed. makkish rotzeach lenaara hameorasa: ma naara hameorasa nittan lehatztzilah benafsho, af rotzeach nittan lehatztzilo benafsho.
Venaara meorasa gufa menalan? kidtana deve rabbi yishmael, detana deve rabbi yishmael: "veen moshia lah" – ha yesh moshia lah, bechol davar sheyyachol lehoshia.

Gufa: minnayin laroe et chavero shehu tovea bannahar, o chayya gorarto, o listin bain alav, shehu chayyayv lehatztzilo? talmud lomar: "lo taamod al dam reecha". veha mehacha nafka? mehatam nafka! avedat gufo minnayin? talmud lomar: "vahashevoto lo".
I mehatam, hava amena: hane mille benafsheh, aval mitrach umegar agore – ema la. ka mashma lan.

Tanu rabbanan: echad harodef achar chavero lehorgo, veachar hazzachar, veachar naara hameorasa, veachar chayyayve mitot bet din, veachar chayyayve charetot – matztzilin otan benafsho. almana lechohen gadol, gerusha vachalutza lechohen hedyot – en matztzilin otan benafsho.
Neevda bah avera – en matztzilin otah benafsho. yesh lah moshia – en matztzilin otah benafsho. rabbi yehuda omer: af haomeret "hannichu lo" shello yahargenna.

Mena hane mille? amar kera: "velannaara lo taase davar en lannaara chet mavet". "naar" – ze zechur, "naara" – zo naara hameorasa, "chet" – ellu chayyayve charetot, "mavet" – ellu chayyayve mitot bet din.
Kol hane lema li? tzerichi, dei ketav rachamana "naar" – mishshum delav orcheh, aval naara deorcha – ema la.
Vei ketav rachamana "naara", mishshum deka fagem la, aval naar dela ka fagem leh – ema la.
Vei ketav rachamana hane,
b: Mishshum dehay lav orcheh hu, veha ka fagem la. aval shear arayot deorchayyhu, vela nefish pigmayyhu, ema la. ketav rachamana "chet".
Vei ketav rachamana "chet", hava amena afillu chayyayve lavin. ketav rachamana "mavet".
Vei ketav rachamana "mavet", hava amena: chayyayve mitot bet din – en, chayyayve charetot – la. ketav rachamana "chet".
Velichtov rachamana "chet mavet", vela bae "naar" venaara"? in, hachi name. veella "naar" "naara"? chad lemaote oved avoda zara, vechad lemaote behema veshabbat.
Ulerabbi shimon ben yochay, deamar: oved avoda zara nittan lehatztzilo benafsho, lema li? chad lemaote behema, vechad lemaote shabbat.
Salka datach amena: tete shabbat mechillul" "chillul" meavoda zara.

Ulerabbi elazar berabbi shimon, deamar: mechallel et hashshabbat nittan lehatztzilo benafsho, deatya shabbat mechillul" "chillul" meavoda zara, may ikka lememar? chad miut lemaote behema, veiddach – ayyeyde dichtav rachamana "naar", ketav name "naara".
Rabbi yehuda omer: af haomeret "hannichu lo" shello yahargenna. bemay kamippalgi?

Amar rava: bemakpedet al pigmah, umannichato shello yahargenna. rabbanan savri: appigma kafed rachamana, vahare makpedet al pigmah. verabbi yehuda: hay dekaamar rachamana katleh – mishshum demasra nafsha liktala. ha la masra nafsha liktala.
Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye: almana lechohen gadol name ka fagem la! amar leh: appigma rabba kafed rachamana, appigma zuta la kafed rachamana.
"Chet" – ellu chayyayve charetot. ureminhu: veellu nearot sheyyesh lahen kenas – habba al achoto.
Amruha rabbanan kammeh derav chisda: mishsheat haaraa defagma, ippetar le mikketala. mamona la meshallem ad gemar bia.
Hanicha leman deamar: haaraa zo neshika, ella leman deamar: haaraa zo hachenasat atara – may ikka lememar?
Ella amar rav chisda: kegon shebba aleha shello kedarkah, vechazar uva aleha kedarkah.
Rava amar: bemannichato, shello yahargenna, verabbi yehuda hi.

a: Rav pappa amar: bimfutta, vedivre hakkol.

Abbaye amar: beyachol lehatztzil beechad meevarav, verabbi yonatan ben shaul hi. detanya: rabbi yonatan ben shaul omer, rodef shehaya rodef achar chavero lehorgo, veyachol lehatztzilo beechad meevarav velo hitztzil – neherag alav.

May tama derabbi yonatan ben shaul? dichtiv: "vechi yinnatzu anashim (yachdav) vegomer". veamar rabbi elazar: bematztzut shebbemita hakkatuv medabbar, dichtiv: "veim ason yihye venatatta nefesh tachat nafesh". vaafillu hachi amar rachamana: "velo yihye ason anosh yeanesh".
I amrat bishlama: yachol lehatztzil beechad meevarav, lo nittan lehatztzilo benafsho – hayeynu demashkachat la deyeanesh, kegon sheyyachol lehatztzil beechad meevarav.
Ella, i amrat: yachol lehatztzil beechad meevarav name nittan lehatztzilo benafsho, hechi mashkachat la deyeanesh?
Dilma shane hacha, demita laze vetashlumin laze.
La shena, deamar rava: rodef shehaya rodef achar chavero, veshibber et hakkelim – ben shel nirdof uven shel kol adam – patur. may tama? mitchayyev benafsho hu.
Venirdof sheshshibber et hakkelim shel rodef – patur, shel kol adam – chayyayv. shel rodef patur, shello yehe mamono chaviv alav miggufo. shel kol adam chayyayv, shemmatztzil atzmo bemamon chavero.

Verodef shehaya rodef achar rodef lehatztzilo, veshibber et hakkelim – ben shel rodef, ben shel nirdof, ben shel kol adam – patur. velo min haddin, sheim i atta omer ken, nimtza en lach kol adam shemmatztzil et chavero miyyad harodef.

Aval harodef achar behema. tanya, rabbi shimon ben yochay omer: haoved avoda zara nittan lehatztzilo benafsho, mikkal vachomer. uma pegam hedyot nittan lehatztzilo benafsho, pegam gavoah lo kol shekken? vechi onshin min haddin?! ka savar: onshin min haddin.
Tanya, rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer: hamechallel et hashshabbat nittan lehatztzilo benafsho. savar la kaavu, deamar: onshin min haddin. veatya shabbat bechillul" "chillul" meavoda zara.

Amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yehotzadak: nimnu vegamru baaliyyat bet natteza belod, kol averot shebbattora im omrin laadam "avor veal tehareg" – yaavor veal yehareg, chutz meavoda zara vegilluy arayot ushefichut damim.
Vaavoda zara la? veha tanya: amar rabbi yishmael, minnayin sheim amru lo laadam "avod avoda zara veal tehareg", minnayin sheyyaavod veal yehareg? talmud lomar "vachay bahem" – velo sheyyamut bahem.
Yachol afillu befarhesya? talmud lomar: "velo techallelu et shem kodshi venikdashti".

Inhu daamur kerabbi eliezer, detanya: rabbi eliezer omer: "veahavta et Adonai elohecha bechol levavcha uvechol nafshecha uvechol meodecha". im neemar "bechol nafshecha", lamma neemar "bechol meodecha"? veim neemar "bechol meodecha", lamma neemar "bechol nafshecha"?
Im yesh lecha adam sheggufo chaviv alav mimmamono, lechach neemar "bechol nafshecha". veim yesh lach adam shemmamono chaviv alav miggufo, lechach neemar "bechol meodecha".
Gilluy arayot ushefichut damim, kidrabbi. detanya, rabbi omer: "ki kaasher yakum ish al reehu uretzacho nefesh ken haddavar hazze". vechi ma lamadnu merotzeach?
Meatta, hare ze ba lelammed venimtza lamed. makkish rotzeach lenaara hameorasa: ma naara hameorasa – nittan lehatztzilo benafsho, af rotzeach – nittan lehatztzilo benafsho.
Umakkish naara hameorasa lerotzeach: ma rotzeach yehareg veal yaavor, af naara hameorasa tehareg veal taavor.

Rotzeach gufeh mena lan? sevara hu, dehahu daata lekammeh derabba vaamar leh: amar li mare duray "zil katleh liflanya, vei la katelna lach". amar leh: liktelucha vela tiktol. mi yemar didma didach summak tefe? dilma dema dehu gavra summak tefe.
Ki ata rav dimi, amar rabbi yochanan: lo shanu ella shello bishat hashshemad, aval bishat hashshemad, afillu mitzva kalla – yehareg veal yaavor.
Ki ata ravin amar rabbi yochanan: afillu shello bishat hashshemad, lo amru ella betzina, aval befarhesya afillu mitzva kalla – yehareg veal yaavor.
May mitzva kalla? amar rava bar rav yitzchak amar rav:
b: Afillu leshannoye arketa dimsana.

Vechamma parhesya? amar rabbi yaakov amar rabbi yochanan: en parhesya pechuta measara bene adam. peshita, yisreelim baenan, dichtiv: "venikdashti betoch bene yisrael". bae rabbi yirmeya: tisha yisrael vegoy echad, mahu?

Ta shema, detane rav yannay achu derabbi chiyyay bar abba: atya "toch" "toch" – ketiv hacha: "venikdashti betoch bene yisrael", uchetiv hatam: "hibbadlu mittoch haeda hazzot". ma lehallan asara vechullehu yisrael, af kan asara vechullehu yisrael.
Veha ester parhesya havay? amar abbaye: ester karka olam hayta.
Rava amar: hanaat atzman shane.
Dei la tema hachi, hane kevavke vedemonike hechi yahavinan lehu? ella hanaat atzman shane. hacha name, hanaat atzman shane.

Veazda rava letameh, deamar rava: goy deamar leh lehay yisrael, "ketol aspasta beshabbeta ushedi lechevata, vei la katelna lach" – liktol vela likteleh. "shedi lenahra" – likteleh vela liktol. may tama? leabbore milleta ka bae.
Beo minneh merabbi amme: ben noach metzvvev al kedushshat hashshem, o en metzvvev al kedushshat hashshem?
Amar abbaye, ta shema: sheva mitzvot nitztauu bene noach. veim ita, tamne havyayn! amar leh rava: inhu vechol avzerayyhu.

May have ala? amar rav adda bar ahava: amri be rav, ketiv: "laddavar hazze yislach Adonai leavdecha bevo adoni vet rimmon lehishtachavot shamma vehu nishan al yadi vehishtachaveti", uchetiv: "vayyomer lo lech leshalom".

a: Veim ita, la lema leh? ha betzina, ha befarhesya.

Amar rav yehuda amar rav: maase beadam echad shennatan enav beishsha achat, veheela libbo tina. uvau veshaalu larofim, veamru: en lo takkana ad shettibbael. amru chachamim: yamut veal tibbael lo. taamod lefanav arumma: yamut veal taamod lefanav arumma. tesapper immo meachore haggader: yamut velo tesapper immo meachore haggader.

Peligi ba rabbi yaakov bar idde verabbi shemuel bar nachmani: chad amar: eshet ish hayta, vechad amar: penuya hayta. bishlama leman deamar eshet ish hayta – shappir, ella leman deamar penuya hayta – may kulle hay?
Rav pappa amar: mishshum pegam mishpacha. rav acha bereh derav ika amar: kede shello yehu benot yisrael perutzot baarayot.

Velinseva minsav? la meyaytva dateh, kidrabbi yitzchak. deamar rabbi yitzchak: miyyom shecharav bet hammikdash, nittela taam bia venittena leovre avera, shenneemar "mayim genuvim yimtaku velechem setarim yinam".
Hadaran alach ben sorer umore.
Mishna veellu hen hannisrafin: habba al ishsha uvittah, uvat kohen shezzinneta.
Yesh bichlal ishsha uvittah: bitto, uvat bitto, uvat beno, uvat ishto, uvat bittah, uvat benah, chamoto, veem chamoto, veem chamiv.
Gemara habba al ishsha shennasa bittah – la katane, ella habba al ishsha uvittah. mikkelal detarvayyhu leissura, uman ninhu? chamoto veem chamoto.
Vekatane: "yesh bichlal ishsha uvittah", mikkelal detarvayyhu ketivi behedya, vehanach midderasha atya.
Hanicha leabbaye, deamar: mashmaut dorshin ikka benayyhu. matnitin manni? rabbi akiva hi.
Ella lerava deamar: chamoto leachar mita ikka benayyhu, matnitin manni? amar lach rava: teni "habba al ishsha shennasa bittah".
Yesh bichlal ishsha uvittah: chamoto, veem chamoto, veem chamiv. leabbaye, ayyeyde deka bae lemitne em chamiv, tane name chamoto veem chamoto.
Lerava, ayyeyde deka bae lemitne em chamiv veem chamoto, tane name chamoto.
Menahane mille? detanu rabbanan: "ish asher yikkach et ishsha veet immah" – en li ella ishsha veimmah. bat ishsha, uvat bittah, uvat benah minnayin?
Neemar kan "zimma", veneemar lehallan "zimma". ma lehallan – bittah uvat bittah uvat benah, af kan – bittah uvat bittah uvat benah.
Minnayin laasot zecharim kinkevot? neemar kan "zimma", veneemar lehallan "zimma". ma lehallan zecharim kinkevot, af kan zecharim kinkevot.
Minnayin laasot lematta kilmala? neemar kan "zimma", veneemar lehallan "zimma". ma lehallan lematta kilmala, af kan lematta kilmala. uma kan lemala kilmatta, af lehallan lemala kilmatta.
Amar mar: minnayin laasot zecharim kinkevot. may "zecharim kinkevot"? illema bat benah kevat bittah? bahade hadade kaatyan!
Ella, em chamiv keem chamoto. hasheta, em chamoto la kama lan, em chamiv mihdar ala?
b: Amar abbaye: hachi kaamar, minnayin laasot sheer habba mimmennu kisher habba mimmenna? neemar kan "zimma" veneemar lehallan "zimma" vechulei. veha bisher dideh la ketiva beh "zimma"!
Amar rava: amar li rav yitzchak bar avudimi, atya "henna" "henna", atya "zimma" "zimma".
Amar mar: minnayin laasot lematta kilmala. may "lematta kilmala"? illema bat benah uvat bittah kevittah, bahade hadade kaatyayn!
Ella, em chamiv veem chamoto kachamoto. hay "lematta kilmala"? "lemala kilmatta" hu! teni: "lemala kilmatta".
I hachi, neemar kan "zimma" veneemar lehallan "zimma", uma hasheta: inhi la ketiva, zimma didhu ketiva?
Amar abbaye: hachi kaamar, minnayin laasot shelosha dorot lemala kishlosha dorot lematta? neemar lematta "zimma" veneemar lemala "zimma". ma lematta shelosha dorot, af lemala shelosha dorot.
Uma baonesh asa lematta kilmala, af baazhara name asa lemala kilmatta.
Rav ashe amar: leolam kidkatane, umay "lematta"? lematta beissur.
I: ma hi – em immah asura, af hu – em immo asura?
Amar abbaye: amar kera "immecha hi", mishshum immo atta mechayyeyvo, vei atta mechayyeyvo mishshum em immo.
Rava amar: ben leman deamar "dun minna uminna", uven leman deamar "dun minna veoke veatra" – la atya.
Leman deamar: dun minna uminna, ma hi em immah asura – af hu name em immo asura. uminna: ma hi bisrefa – af hu name bisrefa.
Leman deamar: serefa chamura, ikka lemifrach. ma lehi – shekken immah bisrefa, tomar behu – sheimmo biskila?
Veod: immo biskila, em immo bisrefa?
Veod: ma hi – lo chillakta bah ben immah leem immah, af hu – name la tachlok bo ben immo leem immo?
Uleman deamar sekila chamura, mehay kusheya la neyduna.
Uleman deamar, dun minna veoke veatra: ma hi – em immah asura, af hu name – em immo asura. veoke beatra: hatam hu devisrefa, aval hacha biskila, kidashkechan beimmo.
Leman deamar serefa chamura, ikka lemifrach:

a: Ma lehi – shekken immah bisrefa, tomar behu – sheimmo biskila?
Veod, hu kehi: ma hi – lo chillakta bah ben bittah leem immah, af hu – lo tachlok bo ben bitto leem immo.
Uleman deamar sekila chamura, mehay kusheya la neyduna.
I: ma hu – kallato asura, af hi – kallatah asura?
Amar abbaye, amar kera: "eshet bincha hi". mishshum eshet bincha atta mechayyeyvo, vei atta mechayyeyvo mishshum eshet benah.
Rava amar: ben leman deamar "dun minna uminna", ben leman deamar "dun minna veoke veatra" – la atya.
Leman deamar: dun minna uminna, ma hu – kallato asura, af hi name – kallatah asura. uminna: ma hu biskila, af hi name biskila.
Leman deamar: sekila chamura, ikka lemifrach: ma lehu – shekken immo biskila, tomar behi – sheimmah bisrefa?
Veod: bittah bisrefa vechallatah biskila? hu beatzmo yochiach, devitto bisrefa vechallato biskila.
Ella: ma hu – lo chillakta bo ben immo lechallato, af hi – lo tachlok bah ben immah lechallatah. uleman deamar serefa chamura, mehay kusheya la neydunen.
Uleman deamar: dun minna veoke veatra, ma hu – kallato asura, af hi – kallatah asura. veoke beatra: hatam hu deviskila, aval hacha – bisrefa, kidashkechan beimmah.
Leman deamar sekila chamura, ikka lemifrach: ma lehu – shekken immo biskila, tomar behi – sheimmah bisrefa?
Veod: ma hu – chillakta bo ben bitto lechallato? af hi – tachlok bah ben bittah lechallatah. uleman deamar name serefa chamura, mehay kusheya la neydunen.
Bitto meanusato minnayin? haamar abbaye: kal vachomer, al bat bitto anush – al bitto lo kol shekken?
Vechi onshin min haddin? galloye milleta vealma hu.
Rava amar, amar li rabbi yitzchak bar avdimi: atya "henna" "henna", atya "zimma" "zimma".
Tane avu derabbi avin: lefi shello lamadnu levitto meanusato, hutzerach hakkatuv lomar "uvat ish kohen".
I: ma bat kohen – hi bisrefa veen boalah bisrefa, af bitto meanusato – hi bisrefa veen boalah bisrefa?
Amar abbaye: amar kera "et aviha hi mechallelet", mi shemmechallelet et aviha – yatzta zo sheaviha mechallelah.
Rava amar: bishlama hatam, appekteh middina devat kohen veokemte addina devat yisrael. hacha, addina deman mokmat leh? addina difnuyay mokmat leh?
Azhara levitto meanusato minnayin? bishlama leabbaye verava, mehecha denafka lehu onesh, mehatam nafka lehu azhara.
Ella lidtane avu derabbi avin, may? amar rabbi ila: amar kera, "al techallel et bittecha lehazenotah".

Matkef la rabbi yaakov achu derav acha bar yaakov: hay "al techallel et bittecha lehazenotah" lehachi hu daata? hay mibbee leh lechidtanya: "al techallel et bittecha lehazenotah" – yachol bechohen hammassi et bitto lelevi veyisrael hakkatuv medabber? talmud lomar: "lehazenotah" – bechillul shebbiznut hakkatuv medabber, bemoser et bitto shello leshem ishut.
Im ken, lema kera "al tachel"! may "al techallel"? shema minna tarte. veabbaye verava, hay "al techallel et bittecha lehazenotah" may avdi leh? amar rabbi mani: ze hammassi et bitto lezaken.
Kidtanya: "al techallel et bittecha lehazenotah". rabbi eliezer omer: ze hammassi et bitto lezaken. rabbi akiva omer: ze hammashhe bitto bogeret.
Amar rav kahana mishshum rabbi akiva: en lecha ani beyisrael ella rasha arum, vehammashhe bitto bogeret. attu hammashhe bitto bogeret lav rasha arum hu?
Amar abbaye:
b: Hachi kaamar: ezehu ani rasha arum? ze hammashhe bitto bogeret. veamar rav kahana mishshum rabbi akiva: heve zahir min hayyoetzcha lefi darko.
Amar rav yehuda amar rav: hammassi et bitto lezaken, vehammassi ishsha livno katan, vehammachzir aveda lenochri – alav hakkatuv omer: "lemaan sefot harava et hatztzemea. lo yove Adonai seloach lo".

Metivi: haohev et ishto kegufo, vehamechabbedah yoter miggufo, vehammadrich banav uvenotav bederech yeshara, vehammassian samuch lefirkan – alav hakkatuv omer: "veyadata ki shalom oholecha ufakadta navcha velo techeta". samuch lefirkan – shane.
Tanu rabbanan: haohev et shechenav, vehamekarev et kerovav, vehannose et bat achoto, vehammalve sela leani bishat dochko – alav hakkatuv omer: "az tikra vaAdonai yaane".
Tanu rabbanan: "oto veethen" – oto veet achat mehen, divre rabbi yishmael. rabbi akiva omer: oto veet shetehen.
May benayyhu? amar abbaye: mashmaut dorshim ikka benayyhu.

Rabbi yishmael savar: "oto veethen" – oto veet achat mehen, shekken belashon yevani korin leachat "hina". veem chamoto – midderasha atya. rabbi akiva savar: "oto veethen" – oto veet shetehen, veem chamoto hacha ketiva.
Rava amar: chamoto leachar mita ikka benayyhu. rabbi yishmael savar: chamoto leachar mita bisrefa, verabbi akiva savar: issura bealma.
Mishna veellu hanneheragin: harotzeach, veanshe ir hanniddachat.
Rotzeach shehikka et reehu beeven o bevarzel, vechavash alav letoch hammayim o letoch haur, veeno yachol laalot mishsham vamet – chayyayv.

Dechafo letoch hammayim o letoch haur, veyachol laalot mishsham vamet – patur. shissa bo et hakkelev, shissa bo et hannachash – patur. hishshich bo et hannachash: rabbi yehuda mechayyev, vachachamim potrin.
Gemara amar shemuel: mippene ma lo neemra "yad" babbarzel? shehabbarzel memit bechol shehu.
Tanya name hachi: rabbi omer, galuy veyadua lifne mi sheamar vehaya haolam shehabbarzel memit bechol shehu, lefichach lo natna tora bo shiur. vehane mille devarzeh mivraz.

Vechavash alav letoch hammayim. resha revuta ka mashma lan, vesefa revuta ka mashma lan. resha revuta ka mashma lan: af al gav delav ihu dechafo, kevan deen yachol laalot mishsham vamet – chayyayv. sefa revuta ka mashma lan: af al gav didchafo, kevan deyachol laalot mishsham vamet – patur.
Kavash – menalan? amar shemuel: deamar kera "o veeva", lerabbot et hametzamtzem.
Hahu gavra detzamtzema lechevta dechavreh beshimsha, umita. ravina mechayyev, rav acha bar rav patar.
Ravina mechayyev, kal vachomer: uma rotzeach shello asa bo shogeg kemezid veones keratzon, chiyyev bo et hametzamtzem.

a: Nezakin, sheasa bahen shogeg kemezid veones keratzon – eno din shechiyyev bahen et hametzamtzem?
Rav acha bar rav poter. amar rav mesharsheya: may tama daavu deabba defoter? amar kera: "mot yumat hammakke rotzeach hu". berotzeach hu dechayyev lan metzamtzem, binzakin la chayyev lan metzamtzem.
Amar rava: kefato umet baraav – patur. veamar rava: kefato bachamma vamet, betzinna vamet – chayyayv. sof chamma lavo, sof tzinna lavo – patur.
Veamar rava: kefato lifne ari – patur, lifne yattushin – chayyayv. rav ashe amar: afillu lifne yattushin name patur, hane azli vehane atu.
Ittemar: kafa alav gigit, ufara alav maaziva – rava verabbi zera, chad amar: chayyayv, vechad amar: patur.
Tistayyaym derava hu deamar patur, deamar rava: kefato umet baraav – patur.

Adderabba, tistayyem derabbi zera hu deamar patur, deamar rabbi zera: hay man deayyeyleh lechavreh beveta deshesha veadlek leh sheraga vamet – chayyayv. tama deadlek leh sheraga, ha la adlek leh sheraga – la.
Amri: hatam, bela sheraga, la matchel havela
b: Beshateh. hacha, bela sheraga name matchel havela beshateh.
(Siman: sullam, teris, sammanin, bakkotel).
Amar rava: dechafo levor, vesullam babbor, uva acher vesilleko, vaafillu hu kadam vesilleko – patur, dividdana deshadyeh yachol laalot hu.
Veamar rava: zarak chetz, uteris beyado, uva acher unetalo, vaafillu hu kadam unetalo – patur, dividdana deshadyeh beh mifsak pesiki gireh.
Veamar rava: zarak bo chetz, vesammanin beyado, uva acher ufizzeran, vaafillu hu kadam ufizzeran – patur, dividdana dishda beh yachol lehitrappeot hava.
Amar rav ashe: hilkach, afillu sammanin bashshuk. amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe: nizdammenu lo sammanin, mahu? amar leh: hare yatza mibbet din zakkay.
Veamar rava: zarak tzeror bakkotel, vechazra laachoreha veharga – chayyayv. vetanna tuna: kegon ellu hamesachakin bechaddur shehargu, bemezid – neheragin, beshogeg – golin.
Beshogeg golin, peshita! bemezid neheragin itzterich leh. mahu detema: hateraat safek hi, mi yemar dehadra? ka mashma lan.
Tane rav tachlifa bar mareva kammeh derabbi avahu: kegon ellu hamesachakin bechaddur shehargu, toch arba ammot – patur, chutz learba ammot – chayyayv.
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe: hechi dame? i deka nicha leh, afillu pureta name. i dela nicha leh, afillu tuva name la. amar leh: setam mesachakin bechaddur, kamma deayyli tefe – menach nicha leh.
Lememra dichhay gavvna kocho hu? ureminhu: hamekaddesh, venafal kiddush al yado o al hatztzad, veachar kach nafal leshoket – pasul.
Hacha bemay askinan? beshotet.
Ta shema: machat shehaya netuna al hacheres, vehizza aleha – safek al hammachat hizza, safek al hacheres hizza umitztza aleha – hazzaato pasul.
Amar rav chinnana bar yehuda mishshemeh derav: "matza" ittemar.
Amar rav pappa: hay man dechafteh lechavreh, veashkel aleh bidka demayya – gire dideh hu, umichayyayv. hane mille bechoach rishon, aval bechoach sheni – gerama bealma hu.
Veamar rav pappa: zarak tzeror lemala vehalcha litzdadin veharga – chayyayv. amar leh mar bar rav ashe lerav pappa: may tama? mishshum dechocho hu? i kocho – tezil leel,

a: Vei lav kocho hu – tezil letachat. ella, koach kachush hu.

Tanu rabbanan: hikkuhu asara bene adam baasara maklot vamet, ben bevat achat, ben beze achar ze – peturin. rabbi yehuda ben betira omer: beze achar ze, haacharon chayyayv, mippene shekkerav et mitato.

Amar rabbi yochanan: ushenehem mikra echad darshu, "veish ki yakke kol nefesh adam". rabbanan savri: "kol nefesh" – ad deikka kol nefesh, verabbi yehuda ben betira savar: "kol nefesh" – kol dehu nefesh.
Amar rava: hakkol modim behoreg et hatterefa shehu patur, begoses bide shamayim shehu chayyayv. lo nechleku ella begoses bide adam. mar medamme leh litrefa, umar medamme leh legoses bide shamayim.
Man dimdamme leh litrefa, may tama la medamme leh legoses bide shamayim? goses bide shamayim la itavid beh maase, hay itavid beh maase.
Uman dimdamme leh legoses bide shamayim, may tama la medamme leh litrefa? terefa – mechattechi simanim, ha la mechattechi simanim.
Tane tanna kammeh derav sheshet: "veish ki yakke kol nefesh adam" – lehavi hammakke et chavero veen bo kede lehamit, uva acher vehemito, shehu chayyayv.
En bo kede lehamit? peshita! ella, yesh bo kede lehamit uva acher vehemito, shehu chayyayv. usetama kerabbi yehuda ben betira.
Amar rava: hahoreg et hatterefa – patur. uterefa sheharag bifne bet din – chayyayv, shello bifne bet din – patur.

Bifne bet din, may tama chayyayv? dichtiv: "uviarta hara mikkirbecha". shello bifne bet din – patur, dehavya la edut shei atta yachol lahazimmah, vechol edut shei atta yachol lahazimmah – lo shemah edut.

Veamar rava: harovea et hatterefa – chayyayv. terefa sherava, bifne bet din – chayyayv, shello bifne bet din – patur. bifne bet din chayyayv, dichtiv: "uviarta hara mikkirbecha". shello bifne bet din patur, dehavya la edut shei atta yachol lahazimmah.
Ha tu lema li? hayeynu hach! harovea et hatterefa itztericha leh. mahu detema: leheve keman dimshammesh met, velippetar? ka mashma lan, demishshum hanaa hu, veha it leh hanaa.
Veamar rava: edim sheheidu bitrefa vehuzzammu, en neheragin. ede terefa shehuzzammu, neheragin. rav ashe amar: afillu ede terefa shehuzzammu en neheragin, lefi sheenan bezomme zommin.

Veamar rava: shor terefa sheharag – chayyayv, veshor shel adam terefa sheharag – patur. may tama? amar kera: "hashshor yissakel vegam bealav yumat". kol hecha dekarena beh "vegam bealav yumat", karenan beh "hashshor yissakel", vechol hecha dela karenan beh "vegam bealav yumat", la karenan beh "hashshor yissakel".
Rav ashe amar: afillu shor terefa name sheharag – patur. may tama? kevan deillu bealim havo petiri, shor name patur.
Shissa bo et hakkelev vechulei. amar rav acha bar yaakov: keshettimtza lomar, ledivre rabbi yehuda – eres nachash ben shinnav hu omed. lefichach: makkish besayif, venachash patur.
Ledivre chachamim, eres nachash meatzmo hu meki. lefichach: nachash biskila, vehammakkish patur.
Mishna hammakke et chavero, ben beeven ben beegrof, vaamaduhu lemita, vehekel mimma shehaya, uleachar mikkan hichbid vamet – chayyayv. rabbi nechemya omer: patur, sheraglayim laddavar.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: et zo darash rabbi nechemya, "im yakum vehithallech bachutz
b: Al mishanto venikka hammakke". vechi taale al datecha shezze mehallech bashshuk veze neherag? ella ze sheamaduhu lemita, vehekel mimma shehaya, uleachar kach hichbid vamet – shehu patur.
Verabbanan, hay "venikka hammakke" may darshi beh? melammed shechovshin oto.
Verabbi nechemya, chavisha mena leh? yalef mimmekoshesh.
Verabbanan name lelfu mimmekoshesh? mekoshesh bar ketala hu, umoshe la hava yada ketaleh bemay. leappoke hay, dela yadinan i bar ketala hu i lav bar ketala hu.
Verabbi nechemya yalef mimmegaddef, dela hava yada i bar ketala hu, vechavshu.
Verabbanan: megaddef – horaat shaa hayta.

Kidtanya: yodea haya moshe rabbenu shehamekoshesh bemita, shenneemar: "mechalleleha mot yumat", ella lo haya yodea beezo mita neherag, shenneemar: "ki lo forash vegomer". aval megaddef lo neemar bo ella "lifrosh lahem al pi Adonai", shello haya moshe yodea im hu ben mita kol ikkar im lav.
Bishlama lerabbi nechemya, hayeynu dichtivi tere umedane: chad – amaduhu lemita vechaya, vechad – amaduhu lemita vehekel mimma shehaya. ella lerabbanan, tere umedane lema li?
Chad amaduhu lemita vechaya, vechad amaduhu lechayyim vamet.
Verabbi nechemya, amaduhu lechayyim vamet – la tzerich kera, shehare yatza mibbet din zakkay.

Tanu rabbanan: hammakke et chavero, vaamaduhu lemita, vechaya – potrin oto. amaduhu lemita vehekel mimma shehaya – omdin oto omed sheni lemamon. veim leachar ken hichbid vamet – hallech achar omed haemtzai, divre rabbi nechemya. vachachamim omrim: en omed achar omed.

Tanya iddach: amaduhu lemita – omdin oto lechayyim. lechayyim – en omdin oto lemita. amaduhu lemita vehekel mimma shehaya – omdin oto omed sheni lemamon, veim leachar ken hichbid vamet – meshallem nezek vatzaar layyorshim.
Meematay meshallem? mishshaa shehikkahu. usetama kerabbi nechemya.
Mishna nitkavven laharog et habbehema, veharag et haadam; lannochri, veharag et yisrael; lannefalim, veharag et ben kayyayma – patur.
Nitkavven lehakkoto al motnav, velo haya bah kede lahamito al motnav, vehalcha lah al libbo, vehaya bah kede lahamito al libbo, vamet – patur. nitkavven lehakkoto al libbo

a: Vehaya bah kede lehamit al libbo, vehalcha lah al motnav, velo haya bah kede lehamit al motnav, vamet – patur.

Nitkavvevn lehakkot et haggadol, velo haya bah kede lehamit haggadol, vehalcha lah al hakkatan, vehaya bah kede lehamit et hakkatan, vamet – patur. nitkavven lehakkot et hakkatan, vehaya bah kede lehamit et hakkatan, vehalcha lah al haggadol, velo haya bah kede lehamit et haggadol, vamet – patur.

Aval nitkavvevn lehakkot al motnav, vehaya bah kede lehamit al motnav, vehalcha lah al libbo, vamet – chayyayv. nitkavvevn lehakkot et haggadol, vehaya bah kede lehamit et haggadol, vehalcha lah al hakkatan, vamet – chayyayv. rabbi shimon omer: afillu nitkavvevn laharog et ze veharag et ze – patur.
Gemara rabbi shimon aheyay? illema assefa, "rabbi shimon poter" mibbee leh!

Ella aresha: nitkavvevn laharog et habbehema veharag et haadam, lannochri veharag et yisrael, lannefalim veharag et ben kayyayma – patur. ha nitkavvevn laharog et ze veharag et ze – chayyayv. rabbi shimon omer: afillu nitkavven laharog et ze veharag et ze – patur.

Peshita! kae reuven veshimon, veamar: "ana liruven ka mikkavvavna, leshimon la ka mikkavvavna" – hayeynu pelugetayyhu. amar: "lechad minnayyhu" – may? i name, kesavur reuven venimtza shimon – may? ta shema, detanya: rabbi shimon omer, ad sheyyomar "lifloni ani mitkavvevn".
May tama derabbi shimon? amar kera: "vearav lo vekam alav", ad sheyyitkavvevn lo. verabbanan, amri deve rabbi yannay: perat lezorek even lego.
Hechi dame? illema deikka tisha goyim veechad yisrael benehen, tippok leh derubba goyim ninhu. i name palga ufalga, sefek nefashot lehakel.
La tzericha, deikka tisha yisrael vegoy echad benehen, dehave leh goy kavua, vechol kavua kemechetza al mechetza dame.

Bishlama lerabbanan deamri: nitkavvevn laharog et ze veharag et ze – chayyayv, dichtiv: "vechi yinnatzu anashim venagfu ishsha hara". veamar rabbi elazar: bematztzut shebbemita hakkatuv medabber, dichtiv: "im ason yihye venatatta nefesh tachat nafesh".

Ella lerabbi shimon, hay "venatatta nefesh tachat nafesh" may aved leh? mamon. vechidrabbi, detanya: rabbi omer, "venatatta nefesh tachat nafesh" – mamon. atta omer mamon, o eno ella nefesh mammash? neemra netina lematta, veneemra
b: Netina lemala: ma lehallan mamon, af kan mamon.
Amar rava: hay detana deve chizkiyya mappeka midderabbi, umappeka midderabbanan. detana deve chizkiyya: "makke adam" umakke behema".

Ma makke behema lo chillakta bah ben shogeg lemezid, ben mitkavven lesheeno mitkavven, ben derech yerida lederech aliyyay – lefotro mamon ella lechayyeyvo mamon. af makke adam lo tachlok bo ben shogeg lemezid, ben mitkavven lesheen mitkavven, ben derech yerida lederech aliyyay – lechayyeyvo mamon ella lefotro mamon.

May "sheen mitkavven"? illema sheen mitkavven kelal – hayeynu shogeg! ella peshita sheen mitkavven laze ella laze, vekatane lechayyeyvo mamon ella lefotro mamon. vei bar ketala hu, may itzterich lemiftereh mamon?
Ella, lav shema minna: lav bar ketala hu, velav bar mamona hu.
Mishna rotzeach shennitarev baacherim – kullan peturin. rabbi yehuda omer: konsin otan lakkippa.

Kol chayyayve mitot shennitarvu ze baze – niddonin bakkalla. hanniskalin bannisrafin – rabbi shimon omer: niddonin biskila, shehasserefa chamura. vachachamim omrim: niddonin bisrefa, shehassekila chamura.
Amar lahen rabbi shimon: illu lo hayta serefa chamura, lo nittena levat kohen shezzinneta. amru lo: illu lo hayta sekila chamura, lo nittena limgaddef uleoved avoda zara.
Hanneheragin bannechnakin, rabbi shimon omer: besayif, vachachamim omrim: bechenek.
Gemara man acherim? illema acherim kesherim, peshita! vetu, beha lema rabbi yehuda: konsin otan lechippa?
(Siman 602).

Amar rabbi avahu amar shemuel: hacha berotzeach shello nigmar dino, shennitarev berotzchim acherim shennigmar dinan, askinan. rabbanan savri: en gomrin dino shel adam ella befanav, hilkach kullan peturin. verabbi yehuda: mifterinhu ligmare name la, kevan derotzchin ninhu. hilkach konsin otan lakkippa.

Resh lakish amar: beadam, dechulle alma la peligi diftiri. aval hacha, beshor shello nigmar dino shennitarev bishvarim acherim shennigmar dinan, kamippalgi. rabbanan savri: kemitat bealim kach mitat hashshor, veen gomrin dino shel shor ella befanav, hilkach kullan peturin. verabbi yehuda savar: konsin otan lakkippa.
Amar rava:

a: I hachi, hayeynu dekatane ala: amar rabbi yose: afillu abba chalafta benehen?
Ella amar rava: hachi kaamar, shenayim shehayu omdin, veyatza chetz mibbenehem veharag – shenehem peturin. veamar rabbi yose: afillu abba chalafta benehen.
Veshor shennigmar dino, shennitarev bishvavrin acherim mealleye – soklin otan. rabbi yehuda omer: konsin otan lakkippa.

Vehatanya: para shehemita veachar kach yalda, im ad shello nigmar dina yalda – vevladah muttar, im mishshennigmar dina yalda – vevladah asur. nitarev baacherim vaacherim baacherim – konsin otan lakkippa. rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer: meviin otan levet din vesoklin otan.

Amar mar: im ad shello nigmar dina yalda, vevladah muttar. veaf al gav dechi negacha havat meyabbera? vehaamar rava: velad hannogachat asur – hi uveladah nagchu; velad hannirbaat asur – hi uveladah nirbeu!
Ema: im ad shello nigmar dina ibbera veyalda – vevladah muttar; im mishshennigmar dina ibbera veyalda – vevladah asur.
Hanicha leman deamar: ze vaze gorem – asur.
b: Ella leman deamar: ze vaze gorem – muttar, may ikka lememar?
Ella amar ravina: ema, im ad shello nigmar dina ibbera veyalda – veladah muttar, veim ad shello nigmar dina ibbera umishshennigmar dina yalda – veladah asur. ubbar yerech immo hu.
Kol chayyayve mitot, shema minna mutere ledavar chamur – have mutere ledavar kal.

Amar rabbi yirmeya: hacha bemay askinan? kegon shehitru bo setam. vehay tanna hu, detanya: ushear chayyayve mitot shebbetora en memitin otan ella beeda veedim vehateraa, vead sheyyodiuhu shehu chayyayv mitat bet din. rabbi yehuda omer: ad sheyyodiuhu beeze mita hu neherag.
Tanna kamma yalef mimmekoshesh, verabbi yehuda omer: mekoshesh horaat shaa hayta.
Hanniskalin bannisrafin, matne leh rav yechezkel lerame bereh: hannisrafin banniskalin, rabbi shimon omer: yiddonu biskila, shehasserefa chamura.
Amar leh rav yehuda: abba, la taytneyeh hachi. may irya disrefa chamura? tippok leh derubba niskalin ninhu! ella: hechi atneyeh?
Hanniskalin bannisrafin, rabbi shimon omer: yiddonu biskila, shehasserefa chamura. i hachi, ema sefa: vachachamim omrim: yiddonu bisrefa, shehassekila chamura. tippok leh derubba nisrafin ninhu!
Hatam, rabbanan hu dekaamru leh lerabbi shimon: ledidach deamrat serefa chamura, la! sekila chamura.
Amar leh shemuel lerav yehuda: shinnana,

a: La tema leh laavuch hachi, detanya: hare shehaya aviv over al divre tora, lo yomar lo: "abba, avarta al divre tora", ella omer lo: "abba, kach ketiv battora". sof sof hayeynu hach! ella omer lo: "abba, mikra katuv battora kach hu".
Mishna mi shennitchayyev bishte mitot bet din – niddon bachamura. avar avera shennitchayyev shete mitot – niddon bachamura. rabbi yose omer: niddon bazzikka harishona shebbaa alav.
Gemara peshita! ella, ittegore ittegur?

Amar rava: hachi bemay askinan? kegon sheavar avera kalla, venigmar dino al avera kalla, vechazar veavar avera chamura. salka datach amena: kevan denigmar dino laavera kalla, hay gavra ketila hu. ka mashma lan.

Bea minneh avu derav yosef bar chama merabba bar natan: mena ha milleta daamur rabbanan, mi shennitchayyev shete mitot bet din niddon bachamura? dichtiv: "veholid ben paritz shofech dam [vegomer] el heharim achal veet eshet reehu timme veel haggillulim nasa enav".
"Veholid ben paritz shofech dam" – besayif, "et eshet reehu timme" – zo eshet ish bechenek, "veel haggillulim nasa enav" – zo avoda zara biskila. uchetiv: "mot yumat damav bo yihye" – biskila.

Matkef la rav nachman bar yitzchak: ema kullehu biskila. "veholid ben paritz shofech dam" – ze ben sorer umore deviskila, "eshet reehu timme" – zo naara hameorasa deviskila, "veel haggillulim nasa enav" – zo avoda zara deviskila.
Im ken, may ka mashma lan yechezkel? dilma tora ka mahdar. im ken, ibbei leh leahdora ki hechi deahdera moshe rabbenu.
Daresh rav acha berabbi chanina: may dichtiv "el heharim lo achol"? shello achal bizchut avotav. "veenav lo nasa el gillule bet yisrael"? shello halach bekoma zekufa.

"Veet eshet reehu lo timme" – shello yarad leummanut chavero, "veel ishsha nidda lo yikrav" – shello nehena mikkuppa shel tzedaka. uchetiv: "tzaddik hu chayo yichye". keshehaya rabban gamliel maggia lemikra hazze, haya boche. amar: man deaved lechullehu hu dechaye, bachada minnayyhu – la?
Amar leh rabbi akiva, ella meatta: "al tittammeu bechol elle", hachi name bechullehu – in, bachada minnayyhu – la? ella: beachat mikkol elle, hachi name: beachat mikkol elle.
Avar avera. tanya: ketzad amar rabbi yose? niddon bezikka rishona habbaa alav. chamoto venaaset eshet ish – niddon bachamoto. eshet ish venaaset chamoto – niddon beeshet ish.
Amar leh rav adda bar ahava lerava: chamoto venaaset eshet ish, niddon bachamoto?
Liddon name aissur eshet ish! deha amar rabbi avahu: mode rabbi yose beissur mosif.
b: Amar leh: adda beri, bitre ketale katlat leh?
Mishna mi shellaka veshana, bet din machnisin oto lakkippa, umaachilin oto seorin ad shekkereso mitbakkaat.

Gemara mishshum delaka veshana, bet din konsin oto lakkippa? amar rabbi yirmeya amar rabbi shimon ben lakish: hacha bemalkiyyot shel karetot askinan, degavra bar ketala hu, vekarove hu dela meykarav ketaleh. vechevan deka mevavtar la lenafsheh, mekarvinan leh liktaleh illaveh.
Amar leh rabbi yaakov lerabbi yirmeya bar tachlifa: ta asbera lach, bemalkiyyot shel karet achat, aval shel shetayim veshel shalosh karetot – issure hu deka taem, vela mevavtar kulle hay.
Mi shellaka veshana. shana af al gav dela shillesh. lema matnitin dela kerabban shimon ben gamliel? dei rabban shimon ben gamliel, ha amar: ad telat zimne la havya chazaka.
Amar ravina: afillu tema rabban shimon ben gamliel, kasavar averot machazikot.

Metivi: avar avera sheyyesh bah malkot, paam rishona usheniyya malkin oto, ushelishit konsin oto lakkippa. abba shaul omer: af bashshelishit malkin oto, barviit konsin oto lakkippa. may lav dechulle alma malkiyyot machzikot, uviflugeta derabbi verabban shimon ben gamliel kamippalgi?
La, dechulle alma it lehu derabban shimon ben gamliel, vehacha beha ka mippalgi: demar savar averot machzikot, umar savar malkiyyot machzikot.
Vehadtanya: hitru bo veshatak, hitru bo vehirkin rosho – paam rishona usheniyya matrin bo, shelishit – konsin oto lakkippa. abba shaul omer: af bashshelishit matrin bo, birviit – konsin oto lakkippa.
Vehatam, malkot lekka. bemay kamippalgi? amar ravina: bechippa tzericha hateraa kamippalgi.
Umay kippa? amar rav yehuda: melo komato. vehecha remiza? amar resh lakish: "temotet rasha raa".
Veamar resh lakish: may dichtiv "ki [gam] lo yeda haadam et itto kaddagim shenneechazim bimtzoda raa"? may "metzoda raa"? amar resh lakish: chakka.
Mishna hahoreg nefesh shello beedim, machnisin oto lakkippa umaachilin oto lechem tzar umayim lachatz.
Gemara mena yadinan? amar rav: beedut meyuchedet. ushemuel amar: shello behateraa.
Verav chisda amar avimi: kegon deittachchush bivdikot vela ittachchush bachakirot, keditnan: maase uvadak ben zakkay beuketze teenim.

Umaachilin oto lechem tzar umayim lachatz. may shena hacha dekatane: notnin lo lechem tzar umayim lachatz, umay shena hatam dekatane: maachilin oto seorin ad shekkereso mitbakkaat? amar rav sheshet: idde veidde notnin lo lechem tzar umayim lachatz ad sheyyuketan mayayno, vahadar maachilin oto seorin ad shekkereso mitbakkaat.

Mishna haggonev et hakkasva, vehamekallel bekosem, vehabboel arammit – kannain pogin bo. kohen sheshshimmesh betumea – en echav hakkohanim meviin oto levet din, ella pirche chehunna motziin oto chutz laazara umefatzyin et mocho bigzirin. zar sheshshimmesh bammikdash – rabbi akiva omer: bechenek, vachachamim omrim: bide shamayim.
Gemara may kasva? amar rav yehuda: keli sharet. vechen hu omer: "veet kesot hannasech". vehecha remiza? "velo yavou lirot kevalla et hakkodesh vametu".
Vehamekallel bekosem. tane rav yosef: yakke kosem et kosmo. rabbanan, veittema rabba bar mari, amri: yakkehu kosem lo ulekono ulemakno.
Vehabboel arammit, bea minneh rav kahana merav:

a: Lo pagu bo kannain, mahu? innashyeh rav ligmareh. akreyu lerav kahana bechelmeh: "bagda yehuda vetoeva neesta veyisrael uvirushalaym ki chillel yehuda kodesh Adonai asher ahev uvaal bat el nechar". ata amar leh: hachi akreyun.

Iddachreh rav ligmareh. "bagda yehuda" – zo avoda zara, vechen hu omer: "ken begadtem bi bet yisrael neum Adonai". "vetoeva neesta veyisrael uvirushalaym" – ze mishkav zechur, vechen hu omer: "veet zachar lo tishkav mishkeve ishsha toeva hi". "ki chillel yehuda kodesh Adonai" – zo zona, vechen hu omer: "lo tihye kedesha mibbenot yisrael". "uvaal bat el nechar" – ze habba al haggoya.

Uchetiv batreh: "yachret Adonai laish asher yaasenna er veone meohole yaakov umaggish mincha laAdonai tzevaot". im talmid chacham hu – lo yihye lo er bachachamim veone battalmidim. im kohen hu – lo yihye lo ben maggish mincha laAdonai tzevaot.
Amar rabbi chiyyay bar avuya: kol habba al haggoya, keillu mitchatten baavoda zara, dichtiv: "uvaal bat el nechar". vechi bat yesh lo leel nechar? ella ze habba al haggoya.

Veamar rabbi chiyyay bar avuya: katuv al gulgolto shel yehoyakim "zot veod acheret". zekeno derabbi perida ashkach hahu gulegulta dahavat shadya beshaare yerushalayim, vahava katuv illavay "zot veod acheret". kavra vahadar nevug, kavra vahadar nevug. amar: hay gulegulta dihoyakim, dichtiv beh "kevurat chamor yikkaver sachov vehashelech mehala leshaare yerushalaym".

Amar: malka hu, velav orach ara levazzoye. shakla, karcha beshirae, veotvay besifta. atay devethu, chazeta. nefakat, amara lehu leshivavataha. amri la: hay deitteta kammayyta hi, dela ka minneshe la. shegarta letannura vekalta. ki ata, amar: hayeynu dichtiv illavay: "zot veod acheret".
Ki ata rav dimi amar: bet dino shel chashmonay gazru, habba al haggoya chayyayv aleha mishshum nidda, shifcha, goya, eshet ish.
Ki ata ravin amar: mishshum 360 – nidda, shifcha, goya, zona. aval mishshum ishut let lehu. veiddach: neshayyhu vadday la mafkeri.
Amar rav chisda: habba limmalech, en morin lo. ittemar name, amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: habba limmalech, en morin lo.
Velo od, ella sheim perash zimri vaharago pinchas – neherag alav. nehpach zimri vaharago lefinchas – en neherag alav, shehare rodef hu.

"Vayyomer moshe el shofte yisrael vegomer". halach shivto shel shimon etzel zimri ben salu, amru lo: hen danin dine nefashot veatta yoshev veshotek?! ma asa? amad vekibbetz esrim vearbaa elef miyyisrael vehalach etzel kozbi. amar la: hishshamei li. amra lo: bat melech ani, vechen tzivva li avi: lo tishshami ella laggadol shebbahem. amar la: af hu nesi shevet hu, vela od ella shehu gadol mimmennu, shehu sheni labbeten vehu shelishi labbeten.

Tefasah bivloritah veheviah etzel moshe. amar lo: ben amram, zo asura o mutteret? veim tomar asura, bat yitro mi hittira lach? nitallema mimmennu halacha. gau kullam bivchiyya, vehayeynu dichtiv: "vehemma vochim petach ohel moed". uchetiv: "vayyar pinchas ben elazar".
Ma raa? amar rav: raa maase venizkar halacha. amar lo: achi avi abba, lo kach limmadtani beridtecha mehar sinay: habboel aramit kannain pogin bo? amar lo: karyayna deiggarta ihu leheve parvavnka.

Ushemuel amar: raa sheen chochma veen tevuna veen etza leneged Adonai. kol makom sheyyesh chillul hashshem, en cholkin kavod larav. rabbi yitzchak amar rabbi eliezer: raa shebba malach vehishchit baam.
"Vayyakom mittoch haeda vayyikkach romach beyado". mikkan, sheen nichnasin bichle zayin levet hammidrash. shalaf shenanah vehinnichah beunekalo, vehaya
b: Nishan veholech al maklo, vechevan shehiggia etzel shivto shel shimon amar: hechan matzinu sheshshivto shel levi gadol mishshel shimon? amru: hannichu lo, af hu laasot tzerachav nichnas. hittiru perushin et haddavar.

Amar rabbi yochanan: shishsha nissim naasu lo lefinchas. echad, shehaya lo lezimri lifrosh velo perash. veechad, shehaya lo ledabber velo dibber. veechad, shekkivvevn bezachruto shel ish uvenakvutah shel ishsha. veechad, shello nishmetu min haromach. veechad, shebba malach vehigbiah et hammashkof. veechad, shebba malach vehishchit baam.

Ba vachavatan lifne hammakom, amar lefanav: ribbono shel olam, al ellu yippelu esrim vearbaa elef miyyisrael? shenneemar "vayyihyu hammetim bammaggefa arbaa veesrim alef". vehayeynu dichtiv: "vayyaamod pinchas vayfallel".

Amar rabbi elazar: "vayyitpallel" lo neemar, ella "vayfallel". melammed kivyachol, sheasa pelilut im kono. bikkeshu malache hashsharet ledochofo. amar lahen: hannichu lo, kannay ben kannay hu, meshiv chema ben meshiv chema hu.
Hitchilu shevatim mevazzin oto: reitem ben puti ze, sheppittem avi immo agalim laavoda zara, veharag nesi shevet miyyisrael? ba hakkatuv veyichaso: "pinchas ben elazar ben aharon hakkohen".
Amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu lemoshe: hakedem lo shalom, shenneemar: "lachen emor hinni noten lo et beriti shalom". ureuya kappara zo shettehe mechapperet veholechet leolam.

Amar rav nachman amar rav: may dichtiv "zarzir motnayim o tayish umelech alkum immo"? arba meot veesrim vearba beilot baal oto rasha oto hayyom, vehimtin lo pinchas ad shettashash kocho. vehu eno yodea shemmelech alkum immo.
Bematnita tana: shishshim, ad shennaasa kevetza hammuzeret, vehi hayta kaaruga melea mayim. amar rav kahana: umoshavah bet sea. tane rav yosef: kever shellah amma.
Amar rav sheshet: lo "kozbi" shemah, ella "shevilnay bat tzur" shemah. velamma nikra shemah "kozbi"? shekkizzeva beaviha. davar acher: "kozbi" – sheamra leaviha: "kos bi am ze".
Vehayeynu deamri inashe: "ben kene leurebane, shevilnay may baaya?" "bahade kelippe dikne, shevilnay may baaya?" gaftah leimma.

Amar rabbi yochanan: chamishsha shemot yesh lo: zimri, uven salu, veshaul, uven hakkenaanit, ushelumiel ben tzuri shadday. zimri – al shennaasa kevetza hammuzeret, ben salu – al shehisli avonot shel mishpachto, shaul – al shehishil atzmo lidvar avera, ben hakkenaanit – al sheasa maase chenaan, uma shemo? shelumiel ben tzuri shadday shemo.
Kohen sheshshimmesh betumea. bea minneh rav acha bar huna merav sheshet: kohen sheshshimmesh betumea, chayyayv mita bide shamayim o en chayyayv mita bide shamayim?

Amar leh: tenetuha, kohen sheshshimmesh betumea en echav hakkohanim meviin oto levet din, ella pirche chehunna motziin oto chutz laazara ufotzin et mocho begizrin. vei salka datach mechayyev bide shamayim, lishbekeh deliktol bide shamayim! ella may? eno chayyayv.

Mi ikka midde derachamana patreh, vaanan nekum veniktol leh? vela? vehatnan: mi shellaka veshana – bet din machnisin oto lakkippa. rachamana patreh, vaanan katlinan leh! haamar rabbi yirmeya amar resh lakish: bemalkot shel karetot askinan, degavra bar ketala hu.
Veha gonev hakkasva? haamar rav yehuda: bichli sharet askinan, uremiza: "lo yavou lirot kevalla et hakkodesh vametu".
Veha hamekallel et hakkosem? ha tane rav yosef: yakke kosem et kosmo, demichaze kimvarech et hashshem.
Veha boel aramit? ha akreyu lerav kahana bechelmeh, veiddachreh rav ligmareh.
Etiveh: hayyotzek, vehabbolel, vehappotet, hammoleach, hammenif, hammaggish, vehamesadder et hashshulechan, hammetiv et hannerot, vehakkometz, vehamekabbel damim bachutz – patur.
Veen chayyayvin alehen

a: Lo mishshum zarut, velo mishshum tumea, velo mishshum mechussar begadim, velo mishshum richutz yadayim veraglayim.
Ha mekatter – chayyayv. may lav, mita? la, beazhara.
Ella zar name leazhara? vehachtiv: "vehazzar hakkarev yumat"! ha kidita veha kidita.
Mikkelal deyotzek uvolel lav name la? vehatanya: azhara leyotzek uvolel minnayin? talmud lomar: "kedoshim yihyu velo yechallelu". midderabbanan, ukera asmachta bealma.
Metivi: veellu hen shebbemita – tame sheshshimmesh. teyuveta!

Gufa: veellu shebbemita – haochel et hattevel, vechohen tame sheachal teruma tehora, vezar sheachal et hatteruma, vezar sheshshimmesh, vetame sheshshimmesh, utevul yom sheshshimmesh, umechussar begadim, umechussar kappara, veshello rachatz yadayim veraglayim, ushetuye yayin, uferue rosh.
Aval arel, veonen, veyoshev – enan bemita ella beazhara. baal mum – rabbi omer: bemita, vachachamim omrim: baazhara.
Hezid bimila, rabbi omer: bemita, vachachamim omrim: baazhara.

Haochel et hattevel, menalan? deamar shemuel mishshum rabbi eliezer: minnayin leochel et hattevel shehu bemita? dichtiv: "velo yechallelu et kodshe bene yisrael [et] asher yarimu laAdonai". baatidim litrom hakkatuv medabber.
Veyalef "chillul" "chillul" mitteruma, ma lehallan bemita – af kan bemita.
Venelaf "chillul" "chillul" minnotar: ma lehallan becharet, af kan becharet.
Mistabbera mitteruma hava leh lemelaf, shekken teruma: chutza laaretz, huttera, berabbim, perot, piggul venotar.
Adderabba, minnotar hava leh lemelaf, shekken pesul ochel, en lo hetter bemikve. hanach nefishan. ravina amar: chillul derabbim mechillul derabbim adif.
Vechohen tame sheachal teruma tehora menalan? deamar shemuel: minnayin lechohen tame sheachal teruma tehora shehu bemita bide shamayim? dichtiv: "veshamru et mishmarti velo yisu alav chet vegomer".
Tehora – in, temea – la. deamar shemuel amar rabbi eliezer: minnayin lechohen tame sheachal teruma temea sheeno bemita? shenneemar: "umetu vo ki yechalleluhu",
b: Perat lazo shemmechullelet veomedet.
Vezar sheachal et hatteruma, amar rav: zar sheachal et hatteruma loke. amri leh rav kahana verav assi lerav: lema mar bemita, dichtiv "vechol zar lo yochal kodesh"?
"Ani Adonai mekaddesham" – hifsik hainyan. metivi: veellu hen shebbemita – zar haochel et hatteruma. matnita adderav ka ramet? rav tanna hu ufaleg!
Vezar sheshshimmesh, dichtiv: "vehazzar hakkarev yumat".

Vetame sheshshimmesh, kediva minneh rav chiyyay bar avin merav yosef: minnayin letame sheshshimmesh shehu bemita? dichtiv: "dabber el aharon veel banav veyinnazru mikkodshe vene yisrael velo yechallelu et shem kodshi".
Veyalef "chillul" "chillul" mitteruma, ma lehallan bemita – af kan bemita.
Venelaf "chillul" "chillul" minnotar: ma lehallan karet, af kan karet?
Mistabbera mitteruma hava leh lemelaf, shekken: guf, tame, mikve, berabbim.
Adderabba, minnotar hava leh lemelaf, shekken kodesh, penim, piggul venotar! chillul derabbim mechillul derabbim adif.
Tevul yom sheshshimmesh, menalan? detanya: rabbi simay omer, remez litvul yom sheim avad chillel minnayin? talmud lomar: "kedoshim yihyu lelohehem velo yechallelu".
Im eno inyan letame sheshshimmesh, denafka lan mivyinnazru", tenehu inyan litvul yom sheshshimmesh.
Veyalef chillul chillul mitteruma, ma lehallan bemita – af kan bemita.
Umechussar begadim menalan? amar rabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan, umatu bah mishshemeh derabbi elazar berabbi shimon: "vechagarta otam avnet".
Bizman shebbigdehem alehem – kehunnatam alehem; en bigdehem alehem – en kehunnatam alehem. vehavu lehu zarim, veamar mar: zar sheshshimmesh – bemita.
Umechussar kappara menalan? amar rav huna: deamar kera "vechipper aleha hakkohen vetahera". tahera, mikkelal shehi temea. veamar mar: tame sheshshimmesh – bemita.
Veshello rechutz yadayim veraglayim, menalan? dichtiv: "bevoam el ohel moed yirchatzu mayim velo yamutu".
Ushetuye yayin, dichtiv: "yayin veshechar al tesht vegomer".
Uferue rosh, dichtiv: "rosham lo yegallechu ufera lo yeshallechu", uchetiv batreh: "veyayin lo yishtu". ittakkash perue rosh lishtuye yayin: ma shetuye yayin bemita, af perue rosh bemita.
Aval arel, onen, yoshev – beazhara. arel menalan? amar rav chisda: davar ze mittorat moshe rabbenu lo lamadnu, ad shebba yechezkel ben buzi velimmedanu: "kol ben nechar erel lev

a: Veerel basar lo yavo el mikdashi (lesharteni)".
Onen menalan? dichtiv: "umin hammikdash lo yetze velo yechallel et mikdash elohav". ha acher shello yatza, chillel.
Amar leh rav adda lerava: venelaf "chillul" "chillul" mitteruma, ma lehallan bemita – af kan bemita.
Mi ketiv beh begufeh? mikkelala kaate. have davar habba min hakkelal, vechol davar habba min hakkelal en danin oto bigzera shava.
Yoshev menalan? amar rava amar rav nachman: amar kera "ki vo bachar Adonai elohecha mikkol shevatecha laamod lesharet". laamida bechartiv, velo lishiva.
Baal mum: rabbi omer bemita, vachachamim omrim baazhara. may tama derabbi? dichtiv: "ach el happarochet lo yavo vegomer", veyalef chillul chillul mitteruma. ma lehallan bemita, af kan bemita.
Venelaf "chillul" "chillul" minnotar: ma lehallan becharet, af kan becharet?
Mistabbera mitteruma hava leh lemelaf, shekken pesul hagguf mippesul hagguf. adderabba, minnotar hava leh lemelaf, shekken kodesh, penim, piggul venotar.
Ella, mittame sheshshimmesh gamar. pesul hagguf mippesul hagguf, kodesh penim piggul venotar mikkodesh penim piggul venotar.
Verabbanan, amar kera: "bo", velo bevaal mum.
Hezid bimila: rabbi omer bemita, vachachamim omrim baazhara. may tama derabbi? amar rabbi avahu: gamar chet chet mitteruma. ma lehallan bemita – af kan bemita.
Verabbanan amri: amar kera "bo", "bo" velo bimila.

Zar sheshshimmesh bemikdash: tanya, rabbi yishmael omer: neemar kan "vehazzar hakkarev yumat", veneemar lehallan "kol hakkarev hakkarev el mishkan Adonai yamut". ma lehallan bide shamayim, af kan bide shamayim.

Rabbi akiva omer: neemar kan "vehazzar hakkarev yumat", veneemar lehallan "vehannavi hahu o cholem hachalom hahu yumat". ma lehallan biskila, af kan biskila. rabbi yochanan ben nuri omer: ma lehallan bechenek, af kan bechenek.

Bemay kamippalgi rabbi yishmael verabbi akiva? rabbi akiva savar: danin "yumat" miyyumat", veen danin "yumat" miyyamut". verabbi yishmael savar: danin hedyot mehedyot, veen danin hedyot minnavi. verabbi akiva: kevan shehiddiach – en lecha hedyot gadol mizze.

Bemay kamippalgi rabbi akiva verabbi yochanan ben nuri? biflugeta derabbi shimon verabbanan, detanya: navi shehiddiach – biskila. rabbi shimon omer: bechenek. ha anan tenan: rabbi akiva omer: bechenek.
Tere tannae veallibba derabbi akiva. matnitin – rabbi shimon veallibba derabbi akiva. barayyta – rabbanan veallibba derabbi akiva.
Hadaran alach ellu hen hannisrafin.
b: Mishna ellu hen hannechnakin – hammakke aviv veimmo, vegonev nefesh miyyisrael, vezaken mamre al pi bet din, unevi hashsheker, vehammitnabbe beshem avoda zara, vehabba al eshet ish, vezomme bat kohen uvoalah.
Gemara makke aviv veimmo menalan? dichtiv: "umakke aviv veimmo mot yumat", vechol mita haamura battora setam – enah ella chenek.
Ema: ad dekatel leh miktal! salka datach? ketal chad besayif, veaviv bechenek?
Hanicha leman deamar chenek kal, ella leman deamar chenek chamur, may ikka lememar?
Ella, middichtiv: "makke ish vamet mot yumat", uchetiv: "o veeva hikkahu veyado vayyamot", shema minna: kol hecha deikka hakkaa setam – lav mita hu.

Veitzterich lemichtav "makke ish", veitzterich lemichtav "kol makke nefesh". dei ketav rachamana "makke ish vamet", hava amena: ish devar mitzva – in, katan – la. ketav rachamana "kol makke nefesh". vei ketav rachamana "kol makke nefesh", hava amena: afillu nefalim, afillu ben shemona. tzerichi.
Veema: af al gav dela aved beh chabbura? allema tenan: hammakke aviv veimmo eno chayyayv ad sheyyaase bahen chabbura!
Amar kera: "makke adam umakke vehema". ma makke vehema – ad deaved ba chabbura, dichtiv ba "nefesh", af makke adam – ad deaved chabbura.
Matkef la rav yirmeya: ella meatta, hichchishah baavanim – hachi name dela michayyayv? ella, im eno inyan lenefesh behema – deha i name hichchishah baavanim chayyayv – tenehu inyan lenefesh adam.
Ella, hekkesha lema li? lechidtanya deve chizkiyya.
Hanicha leman deit leh tanna deve chizkiyya, ella leman delet leh tanna deve chizkiyya, hekkesha lema li?
Ma makke vehema lirfua – patur, af makke adam lirfua – patur.

Deibbaya lehu: ben mahu sheyyakkiz dam leaviv? rav matna amar: "veahavta lereacha kamocha". rav dimi bar chinnana amar: makke adam umakke vehema, ma makke vehema lirfua – patur, af makke adam lirfua – patur.
Rav la shavek livreh lemishkal leh silva. mar bereh deravina la shavek livreh lemiftach leh kevavta, dilma chavel vehavya leh shiggat issur.
I hachi, acher name? acher – shiggat lav, beno – shiggat chenek.
Vehaditnan: machat shel yad littol bah et hakkotz, lechush dilma chavel vehavya la shiggat sekila?
Hatam mekalkel hu.
Hanicha leman deamar: mekalkel patur, ella leman deamar: chayyayv, may ikka lememar?
Man shamat leh deamar: mekalkel bechabbura chayyayv? rabbi shimon hi.

a: Verabbi shimon haamar: kol melacha sheenah tzericha legufah – patur aleha.
Beo minneh merav sheshet: ben mahu sheyyease shaliach leaviv, lehakkoto ulekallo?
Amar lehu: veacher mi hittiro? ella, kevod shamayim adif. hacha name, kevod shamayim adif.
Metivi: uma mi shemmitzva lehakkoto, mitzva shello lehakkoto; mi sheeno mitzva lehakkoto, eno din shemmitzva shello lehakkoto?
May lav idde veidde bimkom mitzva? ha – bivno, ha – beacher.
La, idde veidi la shena beno vela shena acher. vela kashya: kan – bimkom mitzva, kan – shello bimkom mitzva.
Vehachi katane: uma bimkom mitzva, shemmitzva lehakkoto – mitzva shello lehakkoto; shello bimkom mitzva, sheeno mitzva lehakkoto – eno din shemmitzva shello lehakkoto?

Ta shema: hayyotze lehareg uva beno vehikkahu vekillelo – chayyayv, ba acher vehikkahu vekillelo – patur. vehavenan ba: may shena beno umay shena acher? veamar rav chisda: bimsarvin bo latzet veeno yotze.
Rav sheshet moke la besheen mesarvin bo latzet.
I hachi, acher name? acher – gavra ketila hu.
Vehaamar rav sheshet: biyyeysho yashen vamet – chayyayv? hacha bemay askinan? beshehikkahu hakkaa sheen bah shave peruta.
Vehaamar rabbi amme amar rabbi yochanan: hikkahu hakkaa sheen bah shave peruta – loke? may "patur" dekaamar? patur mimmamon.
Michlal divno chayyayv bemamon? ella bedino. hacha name, bedino.
Ella, acher hayeynu tama defatur, deamar kera: "venasi veammecha lo taor" – beose maase ammecha.
Hatinach kelala, hakkaa menalan? demakkeshinan hakkaa liklala.
I hachi, beno name? kidamar rav pinchas: besheasa teshuva. hachi name, besheasa teshuva.
I hachi, acher name? amar rav mari: "beammecha" – bimkuyyam shebbeammecha.
I hachi, beno name?
b: Midde dehave leachar mita.

May hava ala? amar rabba bar rav huna, vechen tana deve rabbi yishmael: lakkol en habben naase shaliach leaviv lehakkoto ulekallo, chutz mimmesit, shehare amra tora: "velo tachmol velo techasse alav".
Mishna hammakke aviv veimmo eno chayyayv ad sheyyaase bahen chabbura. ze chomer bamkallel mibbammakke, shehamekallel leachar mita chayyayv, vehammakke leachar mita patur.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: "aviv veimmo killel" – leachar mita. sheyyachol, hoil vechiyyev bammakke vechiyyev bamkallel, ma makke eno chayyayv ella mechayyim – af hamekallel eno chayyayv ella mechayyim.
Veod, kal vachomer: uma makke sheasa bo shello "beammecha" kivammecha", lo chiyyev bo leachar mita – mekallel shello asa bo shello "beammecha" kivammecha", eno din shello chiyyev bo leachar mita?
Talmud lomar: "aviv veimmo killel" – leachar mita.
Hanicha lerabbi yonatan, dimyaytar leh kera "aviv veimmo". ella lerabbi yoshiyya, may ikka lememar?

Detanya: "ish ish" – ma talmud lomar "ish ish"? lerabbot bat, tumetum, veanderoginos. "asher yekallel et aviv veet immo" – en li ella aviv veimmo. aviv shello immo, immo shello aviv – minnayin? talmud lomar: "aviv veimmo killel" – aviv killel, immo killel. divre rabbi yoshiyya.
Rabbi yonatan omer: mashma shenehen keechad, umashma echad veechad bifne atzmo, ad sheyyifrot lecha hakkatuv "yachdav".
Mena leh? nafka leh miumekallel aviv veimmo mot yumat".
Veiddach, hahu mibbee leh lerabbot bat, tumetum, veanderoginos.
Vetippok leh meish ish"? dibbera tora kilshon bene adam.
Velitne: chomer bammakke mibbamkallel, shehammakke asa bo shello beammecha kivammecha, ma sheen ken bamkallel. kasavar: makkeshinan hakkaa liklala.
Lema: hane tannae kehane tannae? detane chada: kuti – atta metzuvvev al hakkaato, vei atta metzuvvev al killato. vetanya iddach: i atta metzuvvev lo al killato velo al hakkaato.
Savruha, dechulle alma kutim gere emet hen. may lav beha kamippalgi? demar savar: makkeshinan hakkaa liklala, umar savar: la makkeshinan hakkaa liklala.
La, dechulle alma la makkeshinan hakkaa liklala, vehacha beha kamippalgi: mar savar kutim gere emet hen, umar savar kutim gere arayot hen.
I hachi, hayeynu dekatane ala: "veshoro keyisrael"? ella, shema minna: behekkesha peligi. shema minna.

Mishna haggonev nefesh miyyisrael eno chayyayv ad sheyyachnisennu lirshuto. rabbi yehuda omer: ad sheyyachnisennu lirshuto veyishtammesh bo, shenneemar: "vehitammer bo umecharo". haggonev et beno, rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka mechayyev, vachachamim potrin. ganav mi shechetzyo eved vechetzyo ben chorin, rabbi yehuda mechayyev, vachachamim potrin.
Gemara vetanna kamma la bae immur? amar rabbi acha bereh derava: immur pachot mishshave peruta ikka benayyhu.
Bae rabbi yirmeya: genavo umecharo yashen, mahu? machar ishsha leubbarah, mahu? yesh derech immur bechach, o en derech immur bechach?
Vetippok leh delekka immur kelal? la tzericha: yashen – dizga aleh, ishsha – deokma beappe zika. derech immur bechach o en derech immur bechach? may? teku.
Tanu rabbanan: "ki yimmatze ish gonev nefesh meechav" – en li ella ish shegganav, ishsha minnayin? talmud lomar: "vegonev ish".
En li ella ish shegganav, ben ishsha uven ish, veishsha shegganva ish. ishsha shegganva ishsha minnayin? talmud lomar: "umet haggannav hahu" – mikkol makom.

Tanya iddach: "ki yimmatze ish gonev nefesh meechav" – echad haggonev et haish, veechad haggonev et haishsha, veechad ger, veechad eved meshucherar vekatan – chayyayv. genavo velo mecharo, mecharo vaadayin yeshno birshuto – patur. mecharo leaviv o leachiv o leechad min hakkerovim – chayyayv. haggonev et haavadim – patur.

a: Tane tanna kammeh derav sheshet. amar leh: ani shone rabbi shimon omer "meechav" – ad sheyyotziennu mershut echav, veat amrat chayyayv?! teni: patur.
May kusheya? dilma ha rabbi shimon, ha rabbanan.
La salka datach, deamar rabbi yochanan: setam matnitin – rabbi meir, setam tosefta – rabbi nechemya, setam sifra – rabbi yehuda, setam sifre – rabbi shimon, vechullehu allibba derabbi akiva.
Haggonev beno – may tama derabbanan?
Amar abbaye: deamar kera, "ki yimmatze" – perat lematzuy.
Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye: ella meatta, "ki yimmatze ish shochev im ishsha veulat baal", hachi name "ki yimmatze" – perat lematzuy? kegon shel bet peloni dishchichan gabbayyhu, hachi name diftiri?
Amar leh: "ana mivnimtza beyado" kaamena.
Amar rava: hilkach, hane makre dardeke umatnu rabbanan kimtzuyin beyadan damu, ufetiri.
Ganav mi shechetzyo vechulei. tenan hatam, rabbi yehuda omer: en laavadim boshet.
May tama derabbi yehuda? amar kera: "ki yinnatzu anashim yachdav ish veachiv". mi sheyyesh lo achva – yatza eved sheen lo achva.
Verabbanan, achiv hu bemitzvot.
Vehacha, hechi daresh rabbi yehuda?

Savar: "meechav" – leappoke avadim, "bene yisrael" – lemaote mi shechetzyo eved vechetzyo ben chorin, "mibbene yisrael" – lemaote mi shechetzyo eved vechetzyo ben chorin. have miut achar miut, veen miut achar miut ella lerabbot.
Verabbanan, "meechav" leappoke avadim la mashma lehu, deha achiv hu bemitzvot. "bene yisrael" "mibbene yisrael" – chad lemaote eved, vechad lemaote mi shechetzyo eved vechetzyo ben chorin.
Azhara legonev nefesh minnayin? rabbi yoshiyya amar: millo tignov". rabbi yochanan amar: millo yimmachru mimkeret eved". vela peligi, mar ka chashev lav digneva, umar ka chashev lav dimchira.

Tanu rabbanan: "lo tignov" – begonev nefashot hakkatuv medabber. atta omer begonev nefashot, o eno ella begonev mamon? amarta: tze ulemad mishshelosh esre middot shehattora nidreshet bahen, davar hallamed meinyayno. bema hakkatuv medabber? binfashot. af kan binfashot.

Tanya iddach: "lo tignovu" – begonev mamon hakkatuv medabber. atta omer begonev mamon, o eno ella begonev nefashot? amarta: tze ulemad mishshelosh esre middot shehattora nidreshet bahen, davar hallamed meinyano. bema hakkatuv medabber? bemamon. af kan bemamon.
Ittemar: ede geneva veede mechira benefesh shehuzzammu, chizkiyya amar: en neheragin. rabbi yochanan amar: neheragin.
Chizkiyya, deamar kerabbi akiva, deamar: "davar" velo chatzi davar. verabbi yochanan amar: kerabbanan, deamri: "davar", vaafillu chatzi davar.
Umode chizkiyya beedim haacharonim shel ben sorer umore shehuzzammu, shenneheragin, mittoch sheyyecholim lomar harishonim:
b: Lehalekoto banu, vehane acharine kulleh davar ka avdi leh.
Matkef la rav pappa: i hachi, ede mechira name likteleh, mittoch sheyyecholin ede geneva lomar "lehalekoto banu"! vechi tema dekasavar chizkiyya dela lake,
Veha ittemar: ede geneva benefesh shehuzzammu, chizkiyya verabbi yochanan – chad amar: lokin, vechad amar: en lokin. veamrinan: tistayyem dechizkiyya deamar lokin, middeamar chizkiyya: en neheragin.
Dei rabbi yochanan, kevan deamar neheragin, have leh lav shennittan leazharat mitat bet din, vechol lav shennittan leazharat mitat bet din en lokin alav. ihu la lake, inhu hechi laku?

Ella amar rav pappa: beede mechira dechulle alma la peligi deneheragin, ki peligi beede geneva. chizkiyya amar: en neheragin, geneva lechoda kayyma umechira lechuda kayyma. rabbi yochanan amar: neheragin, geneva atchalta dimchira hi.
Umode rabbi yochanan beedim harishonim shel ben sorer umore shehuzzammu, sheen neheragin, mittoch sheyyecholin lomar: "lehalekoto banu".
Amar abbaye: hakkol modim beven sorer umore, vehakkol modim beven sorer umore, umachloket beven sorer umore.
Hakkol modim beven sorer umore: beedim harishonim, sheen neheragin, mittoch sheyyecholin lomar: "lehalekoto banu".
Vehakkol modim beven sorer umore: beedim acharonim shenneheragim, mittoch sheedim harishonim yecholin lomar: "lehalekoto banu", vehane kulleh davar ka avdi leh.
Umachloket beven sorer umore: shenayim omrim "befanenu ganav", ushenayim omrim: "befanenu achal".
Amar rav assi: ede mechira benefesh shehuzzammu en neheragin, mittoch sheyyachol lomar "avdi macharti".
Amar rav yosef: keman azla ha shemata derav assi? kerabbi akiva, deamar: "davar", velo chatzi davar. amar leh abbaye: dei kerabbanan, neheragin? ha "mittoch" kaamar!
Ella, afillu tema rabbanan, uvidla ato ede geneva. i hachi, may lememra? la tzericha, deaf al gav daato levassof.
Veakkatti may lememra? la tzericha, deka merammezi rammoze. mahu detema: remiza milleta hi? ka mashma lan: remiza lav kelum hu.

Mishna zaken mamre al pi bet din, shenneemar: "ki yippale mimmecha davar lammishpat". shelosha batte dinin hayu sham: echad yoshev al petach har habbayit, veechad yoshev al petach haazara, veechad yoshev belishkat haggazit.
Bain laze sheal petach har habbayit, veomer: kach darashti, vechach darshu chaveray. kach limmadti, vechach limmedu chaveray. im shamu, amru lahem.
Veim lav, bain lahen leotan sheal petach azara, veomer: kach darashti vechach darshu chaveray, kach limmadti vechach limmedu chaveray. im shomu, amru lahem.

Veim lav, ellu vaellu bain levet din haggadol shebbelishkat haggazit, shemmimmennu yotza tora lechol yisrael, shenneemar: "min hammakom hahu asher yivchar Adonai". chazar leiro, shana velimmed badderech shehaya lamed – patur, veim hora laasot – chayyayv, shenneemar: "vehaish asher yaase vezadon". eno chayyayv ad sheyyore laasot.
Talmid shehora laasot – patur. nimtza chumero kullo.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: "ki yippale mimmecha davar" –

a: Bemufela shebbevet din hakkatuv medabber. "mimmecha" – ze yoetz, vechen hu omer: "mimmech yatza choshev al Adonai raa yoetz beliyyaal". "davar" – zo halacha. "lammishpat" – ze haddin.
"Ben dam ledam" – ben dam nidda, dam leda, dam ziva. "ben din ledin" – ben dine nefashot, dine mamonot, dine makkot. "ben nega lanega" – ben nige adam, nige vattim, nige vegadim.
"Divre" – ellu hacharamim, vehaarachin, vehahekdeshot. "rivot" – zo hashekaat sota, vaarifat egla, vetohorat metzora. "bisharecha" – zo leket, shichcha, ufea.
"Vekamta" – mibbet din. "vealita" – melammed shebbet hammikdash gavoah meeretz yisrael, veeretz yisrael gavoah mikkol haaratzot. "el hammakom" – melammed shehammakom gorem.

Bishlama bet hammikdash gavoah meeretz yisrael, dichtiv: "vealita". ella eretz yisrael gavoah mikkol haaratzot mena leh? dichtiv: "lachen hinne yamim baim neum Adonai lo yeamer chay Adonai asher heela et bene yisrael meeretz mitzrayim. ki im chay Adonai asher heela vaasher hevi et zera bet yisrael meeretz tzafona umikkol haaratzot asher hiddachtim sham veyashvu al admatam".

Tanu rabbanan: zaken mamre eno chayyayv ella al davar shezzedono karet veshiggato chattat, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: al davar sheikkaro middivre tora uferusho middivre sofrim. rabbi shimon omer: afillu dikduk echad middikidduke sofrim.

May tama derabbi meir? gamar "davar" "davar". ketiv hacha: "ki yippale mimmecha davar lammishpat", uchetiv hatam: "venelam davar meene hakkahal". ma lehallan davar shechayyayv al zedono karet veal shiggato chattat, af kan davar shechayyayv al zedono karet veal shiggato chattat.
Verabbi yehuda: "al pi hattora asher yorucha" – ad deikka "tora" veyorucha".
Verabbi shimon: "asher yaggidu lecha min hammakom hahu" – afillu kol dehu.
Amar leh rav huna bar chinnana lerava: targema li leha matnita allibba derabbi meir. amar leh rava lerav pappa: pok targema leh.

"Ki yippale" – bemufela shebbevet din hakkatuv medabber. "mimmecha" – ze yoetz, sheyyodea leabber shanim velikboa chodashim. keditnan: hen heidu shemmeabberim et hashshana kol adar, shehayu omrim ad happurim.
Dei lehay gisa, ka share chametz befesach. vei lehay gisa, ka share chametz befesach.
Davar ze – halacha. zo hilchat achad asar. deittemar: asiri, rabbi yochanan amar: asiri kitshii, verabbi shimon ben lakish amar: asiri keachad asar.
Rabbi yochanan amar, asiri kitshii: ma teshii bae shimmur – af asiri bae shimmur.
Resh lakish amar, asiri keachad asar: ma achad asar lo bae shimmur – af asiri la bae shimmur.
"Mishpat" – ze haddin.
b: Din bitto meanusato.
Deamar rava: amar li rav yitzchak bar avudimi, atya "henna" "henna",
Atya "zimma" "zimma".
"Ben dam ledam" – ben dam nidda, dam leda, dam ziva. dam nidda – biflugeta akavya ben mahalalel verabbanan, ditnan: dam hayyarok – akavya ben mahalalel metamme, vachachamim metaharin.
Dam leda – biflugeta derav velevi, deittemar, rav amar: mayan echad hu, hattora timmeattu vehattora tiharattu.
Velevi amar: shene maayaynot hen, nistam hattame – niftach hattahor, nistam hattahor – niftach hattame.
Dam ziva – biflugeta derabbi eliezer verabbi yehoshua. ditnan: kishsheta shelosha yamim betoch achad asar yom, im shafta meet leet veyalda – hare zo yoledet bezov, divre rabbi eliezer.
Verabbi yehoshua omer: layla vayom, kelele shabbat veyomo, sheshshafta min hatztzaar velo min haddam.

"Ben din ledin" – ben dine mamonot, dine nefashot, dine makkot. dine mamonot – biflugeta dishmuel verabbi avahu, deamar shemuel: shenayim sheddanu dinehem din, ella shennikrain bet din chatzuf. verabbi avahu amar: ledivre hakkol en dinehen din.
Dine nefashot – biflugeta derabbi verabbanan. detanya: rabbi omer, "venatatta nefesh tachat nafesh" – mamon.
Atta omer mamon, o eno ella nefesh mammash? neemar "netina" lemala, veneemar "netina" lematta. ma lehallan mamon, af kan mamon.
Dine makkot – biflugeta derabbi yishmael verabbanan, ditnan: makkot bishlosha. mishshum rabbi yishmael amru: beesrim ushelosha.
"Ben nega lanega" – ben nige adam, nige vattim, nige vegadim.

Nige adam – biflugeta derabbi yehoshua verabbanan. ditnan: im baheret kadam lassear hallavan – tame, im sear lavan kadam labbaheret – tahor, safek – tame. rabbi yehoshua omer: keha. may keha? amar rava: keha – tahor.

Nige vattim, biflugeta derabbi elazar berabbi shimon verabbanan. ditnan: rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer, leolam en habbayit tame ad sheyyerae kishne gerisin al shete avanim, bishne chetalim bekeren zavit. orko kishne gerisin, verochbo kigris.
May tama derabbi elazar berabbi shimon? ketiv "kir" uchetiv "kirot". ezehu kir shehu kekirot? heve omer: ze keren zavit.
Nige vegadim – biflugeta derabbi yonatan ben avtulemos verabbanan. detanya: rabbi yonatan ben avtulemos omer, minnayin

a: Lifricha bivgadim, shehi tehora?
Neemra karachat vegabbachat baadam, veneemra karachat vegabbachat bivgadim. ma lehallan – parach bechullo tahor, af kan – parach bechullo tahor.

"Divre" – ellu haarachin, vehacharamim, vehahekdeshot. haarachin – biflugeta derabbi meir verabbanan, ditnan: hammaarich pachot mibben chodesh, rabbi meir omer: noten damav, vachachamim omrim: lo amar kelum.
Hacharamim – biflugeta derabbi yehuda ben betira verabbanan. ditnan, rabbi yehuda ben betira omer: setam charamim levedek habbayit, shenneemar: "kol cherem kodesh kodashim hu laAdonai".

Vachachamim omrim: setam charamim lakkohen, shenneemar: "kisde hacherem lakkohen tihye achuzzato". im ken, ma talmud lomar: "kodesh kadashim hu laAdonai"? shechal al kodshe kadashim veal kadashim kallim.
Hekdeshot, biflugeta derabbi eliezer ben yaakov verabbanan. detanya, rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: afillu tzinnora shel hekdesh tzericha asara bene adam lifdotah.

"Rivot" – ze hashekaat sota, vaarifat haegla, vetohorat metzora. hashekaat sota – biflugeta derabbi eliezer verabbi yehoshua, ditnan: hamekanne leishto, rabbi eliezer omer: mekanne al pi shenayim, umashke al pi ed echad o al pi atzmo.
Rabbi yehoshua omer: mekanne al pi shenayim, umashke al pi shenayim.

Arifat egla – biflugeta derabbi eliezer verabbi akiva. ditnan: meayin hayu moddin? rabbi eliezer omer: mittibburo, rabbi akiva omer: mechotmo, rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: mimmakom shennaase chalal – mitztzavvaro.

Tohorat metzora – biflugeta derabbi shimon verabbanan. ditnan: en lo bohen yad, bohen regel, ozen yemanit – en lo tohora olamit. rabbi eliezer omer: noten lo al mekomo veyotze. rabbi shimon omer: noten al shel semol veyotze.
"Bisharecha" – ze leket, shichcha, pea. leket – ditnan: shene shibbolin – leket, shelosha – enan leket. shichcha – shene omarin – shichcha, shelosha – enan shichcha.
Veal kullan bet shammay omrim: shalosh leani, vearba levaal habbayit.
