Pea – biflugeta derabbi yishmael verabbanan. ditnan: mitzvat pea lehaferish min hakkama. lo hifrish min hakkama – yafrish min hoomarin. lo hifrish min hoomarin – yafrish min hakkeri ad shello mercho. mercho – measser venoten lo.
Mishshum rabbi yishmael amru: af mafrish min haissa.
Shelosha batte dinin vechulei. amar rav kahana: hu omer mippi hashshemua, vehen omrin mippi hashshemua – eno neherag.

Hu omer: "kach hu beenay", vehen omrin: "kach hu beenenu" – eno neherag. vechol shekken hu omer: "mippi hashshemua", vehen omrin: "kach hu beenenu" – eno neherag. ad sheyyomar: "kach hu beenay", vehen omrim: "mippi hashshemua". teda, shehare lo hargu et akavya ben mahalalel.

Verabbi elazar omer: afillu hu omer "mippi hashshemua", vehen omrin "kach hu beenenu" – neherag, kede shello yirbu machlokot beyisrael. veim tomar: mippene ma lo hargu et akavya ben mahalalel? mippene shello hora halacha lemaase.

Tenan: kach darashti, vechach darshu chaveray; kach limmadti, vechach limmedu chaveray. may lav? dehu amar "mippi hashshemua", vehem omrin: "kach hu beenenu"? la, hu omer: "kach hu beenay", vehem omrim mippi hashshemua.
Ta shema, deamar rabbi yoshiyya: shelosha devarim sach li zeera meanshe yerushalayim: baal shemmachal al kinnuyo – kinnuyo machul.
b: Ben sorer umore, sheratzu aviv veimmo limchol lo – mochalin lo.
Zaken mamre sheratzu bet dino limchol lo – mochalin lo. ucheshebbati etzel chaveray shebbaddarom, al shenayim hodu li, al zaken mamre lo hodu li, kede shello yirbu machlokot beyisrael. teyuveta.

Tanya, amar rabbi yose: mittechilla lo hayu (marbin) machlokot beyisrael, ella bet din shel shivim veechad yoshvin belishkat haggazit, ushene batte dinin shel esrim ushelosha, echad yoshev al petach har habbayit veechad yoshev al petach haazara, ushear batte dinin shel esrim ushelosha yoshvin bechol ayyrot yisrael.

Hutzerach haddavar lishol, shoalin mibbet din shebbeiran. im shamu, amru lahen. veim lav, bain laze shessamuch leiran. im shamu, amru lahem. veim lav, bain laze sheal petach har habbayit. im shamu, amru lahem. veim lav, bain laze sheal petach haazara.

Veomer: kach darashti vechach darshu chaveray, kach limmadti vechach limmedu chaveray. im shamu, amru lahem. veim lav, ellu vaellu bain lelishkat haggazit, sheshsham yoshvin mittamid shel shachar ad tamid shel ben haarbayim.
Uveshabbatot uveyamim tovim, yoshvin bachel. nishala sheela bifnehem, im shamu – amru lahem, veim lav – omdin lamminyan. rabbu hametammeim – timmeu, rabbu hammetaharin – tiharu.
Mishsherabbu talmide shammay vehillel shello shimmeshu kol tzarkan, rabbu machlokot beyisrael venaaset tora kishte torot.

Mishsham kotvin vesholchin bechol mekomot: kol mi shehu chacham, ushefal berech, vedaat habberiyyot nocha hemennu – yehe dayyayn beiro. mishsham maalin oto lehar habbayit, mishsham laazara, mishsham lelishkat haggazit.
Shelachu mittam: ezehu ben haolam habba? anvevtan ushefal berech, shayef ayel shayef venafek, vegares beorayyta tedira, vela machzek tevuta lenafsheh. yehavu beh rabbanan enayyhu berav ulla bar abba.
Chazar leiro veshana. tanu rabbanan: eno chayyayv ad sheyyaase kehoraato, o sheyyore laacherim veyaasu kehoraato.

Bishlama yore laacherim veyaasu kehoraato – meikkara lav bar ketala hu, vehasheta bar ketala hu. ella sheyyaase kehoraato? meikkara name bar ketala hu! hatinach hecha deori bechelev vadam, demeikkara lav bar ketala hu vehasheta bar ketala hu. ella hecha deori bechayyayve mitot bet din, meikkara name bar ketala hu!
Meikkara – bae hateraa, hasheta – la bae hateraa.
Mesit, dela bae hateraa, may ikka lememar? meikkara, i amar tama – mekabbelinan minneh. hasheta, i amar tama – la mekabbelinan minneh.
Mishna chomer bedivre sofrim mibbedivre tora. haomer: "en tefillin", kede laavor al divre tora – patur. "chamesh totafot", lehosif al divre sofrim – chayyayv.

Gemara amar rabbi elazar amar rabbi oshaya: eno chayyayv ella al davar sheikkaro middivre tora uferusho middivre sofrim, veyesh bo lehosif, veim hosif gorea. veen lanu ella tefillin, allibba derabbi yehuda.
Vehaikka lulav, deikkaro middivre tora uferusho middivre sofrim, veyesh bo lehosif, veim hosif – gorea?
Belulav, may sevira lan? i sevira lan delulav en tzarich eged, hay lechodeh kae vehay lechodeh kae. vei sevira lan detzarich eged, garua veomed hu.
Vehaikka tzitzit, deikkaro middivre tora uferusho middivre sofrim, veyesh bo lehosif, veim hosif – gorea?
Betzitzit, may sevira lan? i sevira lan dekesher haelyon lav deorayyta, hay lechodeh kae vehay lechodeh kae. vei sevira lan

a: Dekesher haelyon deorayyta, garua veomed.

I hachi, tefillin name? i avad arbea batte, veayyti acharina veannach gabbayyhu – hay lechodeh kae vehay lechodeh kae. vei avad chamsha batte – garua veomed hu! haamar rabbi zera: bayit chitzon sheeno roe et haavir – pasul.

Mishna en memitin oto lo bevet din shebbeiro, velo bevet din shebbeyavne, ella maalin oto levet din haggadol shebbirushalayim. umeshammerin oto ad haregel, umemitin oto baregel, shenneemar: "vechol haam yishmeu veyirau velo yezidun od". divre rabbi akiva. rabbi yehuda omer: en meannin et dino shel ze, ella memitin oto miyyad, vechotvin vesholchin sheluchin bechol hammekomot: "ish peloni mitchayyev mita bevet din".

Gemara tanu rabbanan: en memitin oto lo bevet din shebbeiro velo bevet din shebbeyavne, ella maalin oto levet din haggadol shebbirushalayim umeshammerin oto ad haregel, umemitin oto baregel, shenneemar: "vechol haam yishmeu veyirau". divre rabbi akiva.

Amar lo rabbi yehuda: vechi neemar "yiru veyirau"? vahalo lo neemar ella "yishmeu veyirau"! lamma meannin dino shel ze? ella, memitin oto miyyad, vechotvin vesholchin bechol makom: "ish peloni nitchayyev mita bevet din".

Tanu rabbanan: arbaa tzerichin hacheraza – hammesit, uven sorer umore, vezaken mamre, veedim zommin. bechullehu ketiv behu "vechol haam" vechol yisrael". beedim zommin ketiv "vehannisharim"? dela kulle alma chazu lesahaduta.
Mishna nevi hashsheker hammitnabbe ma shello shama, uma shello neemar lo – mitato bide adam.
Aval hakkovesh et nevuato, vehamevavter al divre navi, venavi sheavar al divre atzmo – mitato bide shamayim, shenneemar: "anochi edrosh meimmo".
Hammitnabbe beshem avoda zara, veomer: "kach amra avoda zara", afillu kivvevn et hahalacha letamme et hattame uletaher et hattahor.
Habba al eshet ish, kevan shennichnesa lirshut habbaal lenissuin, af al pi shello nivala, habba aleha hare ze bechenek.
Vezomme bat kohen uvoalah, shekkol hammuzammin makdimin leotah mita, chutz mizzomme bat kohen uvoalah.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: shelosha mitatan bide adam, ushelosha mitatan bide shamayim. hammitnabbe ma shello shama, uma shello neemar lo, vehammitnabbe beshem avoda zara – mitatan bide adam. hakkovesh et nevuato, vehamevavter al divre navi, venavi sheavar al divre atzmo – mitatan bide shamayim.

Menahane mille? amar rav yehuda amar rav, deamar kera: "ach hannavi asher yazid ledabber davar bishmi". ze hammitnabbe ma shello shama. "vaasher lo tzivvitiv" – ha lachavero tzivvitiv, ze hammitnabbe ma shello neemar lo. "vaasher yedabber beshem elohim acherim" – ze hammitnabbe beshem avoda zara. uchetiv: "umet hannavi hahu". vechol mita haamura betora setam – enah ella chenek.

Hakkovesh et nevuato, vehamevavter al divre navi, venavi sheavar al divre atzmo – mitatan bide shamayim. dichtiv: "vehaish asher lo yishma". keri beh: "lo yashmia", ukeri beh: "lo yishma el devaray". uchetiv: "anochi edrosh meimmo" – bide shamayim.

Hammitnabbe ma shello shama, kegon tzidkiyya ven kenaana, dichtiv: "vayyaas lo tzidkiyyahu ven kenaana karne varzel". may hava leh lemebad? ruach navot atiteh, dichtiv: "vayyomer Adonai mi yefatte et achav veyaal veyippol beramot gilad". "vayyetze haruach vayyaamod lifne Adonai vayyomer ani afattennu". "vayyomer tefatte vegam tuchol tze vaase chen".
Amar rav yehuda: may "tze"? tze mimmechitzati. may ruach? amar rabbi yochanan: rucho shel navot hayyizreeli.
Hava leh lemedak, kidrabbi yitzchak, deamar rabbi yitzchak: signon echad ole lechamma neviim, veen shene neviim mitnabbein besignon echad.
Ovadya amar: "zedon libbecha hishshiecha". yirmeya amar: "tiflatztecha hishshi otach zedon libbecha". vehane, middekaamri kullehu kahadade, shema minna la kelum kaamri.

Dilma la hava yada leh leha derabbi yitzchak? yehoshafat hava hatam, vekaamar lehu. dichtiv: "vayyomer yehoshafat haen po navi od laAdonai". amar leh: ha ikka kol hane. amar leh: kach mekubbelani mibbet avi abba: signon echad ole lechamma neviim, veen shene neviim mitnabbeim besignon echad.

Hammitnabbe ma shello neemar lo: kegon chananya ben azzur, dekae yirmeya beshuk haelyon vekaamar: "ko amar Adonai [tzevaot] hinni shover et keshet elam". nasa chananya kal vachomer beatzmo: ma elam shello ba ella laazor et bavel amar hakkadosh baruch hu "hinni shover et keshet elam", kasdim atzman al achat kamma vechamma. ata ihu beshuk hattachton amar: "ko amar Adonai vegomer shavarti et ol melech bavel".
Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye: hay lachavero name lo neemar! amar leh: kevan deityehiv kal vachomer lemidrash, keman deittemar leh dame. hu nihu delo neemar lo.
Hammitnabbe beshem avoda zara: kegon nevie habbaal.
Hakkovesh et nevuato: kegon yona ben amittay. vehamevavter al divre navi: kegon
b: Chavreh demicha, dichtiv: "veish echad mibbene hanneviim amar el reehu bidvar Adonai hakkeni na, vaymaen haish lehakkoto", uchetiv: "vayyomer lo yaan asher lo shamata [vegomer]".
Venavi sheavar al divre atzmo: kegon iddo hannavi, dichtiv: "ki chen tzivva oti", uchetiv: "vayyomer lo gam ani navi kamocha", uchetiv: "vayyashov itto", uchetiv: "vayyelech vayyimtzaehu arye".
Tane tanna kammeh derav chisda: hakkovesh et nevuato loke. amar leh: "man deachel tamre bearbela lake? man matre beh? amar abbaye: chavreh nevie.
Mena yadi? amar abbaye: dichtiv "ki lo yaase Adonai [elohim] davar ki im gala sodo". vedilma hadaru beh? im ita dehadri beh, odoe havo modi lechullehu nevie.
Veha yona, dahadaru beh vela odu? yona meikkara "ninve nehpachet" amaru leh. ihu la yeda i letova i leraa.
Hamevavter al divre navi, mena yada deianash? dihav leh ot. veha micha, dela yehav leh ot, veianash? hecha demuchezak shane.
Dei la tema hachi, avraham behar hammoriyya, hechi shema leh yitzchak? eliyyahu behar hakkarmel, hechi samchi aleh veavdi shechute chutz? ella hecha demuchezak shane.
"Vayhi achar haddevarim haelle vehaelohim nissa et avraham", achar may?

Amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi yose ben zimra: achar devarav shel satan, dichtiv "vayyigdal hayyeled vayyiggamal vegomer". amar satan lifne hakkadosh baruch hu: ribbono shel olam, zaken ze chananto lemea shana peri veten, mikkol seuda sheasa lo haya lo tor echad o gozal echad lehakeriv lefanecha? amar lo: kelum asa ella bishvil beno? im ani omer lo "zevach et bincha lefanay" miyyad zovcho. miyyad "vehaelohim nissa et avraham".

"Vayyomer kach na et bincha". amar rabbi shimon bar abba: en "na" ella leshon bakkasha. mashal lemelech basar vadam sheamdu alav milchamot harebe, vehaya lo gibbor echad venitztzechan. leyamim amda alav milchama chazaka. amar lo: bevakkasha mimmecha, amod li bemilchama zo, shello yomru rishonot en bahem mammash. af hakkadosh baruch hu amar leavraham: nisseticha bechamma nisyonot veamadta bechullan. achshav amod li benissayon ze, shello yomru en mammash barishonim.
"Et bincha". shene banim yesh li. "et yechidcha". ze yachid leimmo veze yachid leimmo. "asher ahavta". tarvayyhu rachemna lehu. "et yitzchak". vechol kach lamma? kede shello tittaref dato alav.
Kedamo satan ladderech. amar lo: "hanissa davar elecha tile... hinne yissarta rabbim veyadayim rafot techazzek. koshel yekimun millecha... ki atta tavo elecha vattele". amar lo: "ani betummi elech".

Amar lo: "halo yiratcha kislatecha". amar lo: "zechor na mi hu naki avad". kevan dachaza dela ka shamay leh, amar leh: "veelay davar yegunnav". kach shamati meachore happargod: "hasse leola" veen yitzchak leola. amar lo: kach onsho shel badday, sheafillu amar emet en shomin lo.

Rabbi levi amar: achar devarav shel yishmael leyitzchak. amar lo yishmael leyitzchak: ani gadol mimmecha bemitzvot, sheatta malta ben shemonat yamim, vaani ben shelosh esre shana. amar lo: uveever echad atta megare bi? im omer li hakkadosh baruch hu "zevach atzmecha lefanay", ani zoveach. miyyad: "vehaelohim nissa et avraham".
Tanu rabbanan: navi shehiddiach – biskila. rabbi shimon omer: bechenek. maddiche ir hanniddachat – biskila. rabbi shimon omer: bechenek.
Navi shehiddiach – biskila. may tama derabbanan? atya "haddacha" "haddacha" mimmesit: ma lehallan biskila, af kan biskila.
Verabbi shimon: mita ketiva beh, vechol mita haamura betora setam – enah ella chenek.
Maddiche ir hanniddachat biskila, may tama derabbanan? gemiri "haddacha" "haddacha", o mimmesit, o minnavi shehiddiach.
Verabbi shimon gamar "haddacha" "haddacha" minnavi.
Veligmar mimmesit! danin mesit rabbim mimmesit rabbim, veen danin mesit rabbim mimmesit yachid. adderabba, danin hedyot mehedyot, veen danin hedyot minnavi!
Verabbi shimon, kevan shehiddiach – en lecha hedyot gadol mizze.
Amar rav chisda:

a: Machloket beoker hagguf daavoda zara, vekiyyum miktzat uvittul miktzat daavoda zara, derachamana amar: "min hadderech" – afillu miktzat hadderech.
Aval oker hagguf dishar mitzvot, divre hakkol bechenek. vekiyyum miktzat uvittul miktzat devishar mitzvot, divre hakkol patur.
Metiv rav hamenuna: "lalechet" – zo mitzvat ase, "bah" – zo mitzvat lo taase. vei salka datach baavoda zara, ase baavoda zara hechi mashkachat la? targema rav chisda: "venittatztem".
Rav hamenuna amar: machaloket beoker hagguf, ben baavoda zara ben bishar mitzvot, vekiyyum miktzat uvittul miktzat daavoda zara. derachamana amar: "min hadderech", afillu miktzat hadderech.
Aval kiyyum miktzat uvittul miktzat, devishar mitzvot – divre hakkol patur.

Tanu rabbanan: hammitnabbe laakor davar min hattora – chayyayv. lekayyem miktzat ulevattel miktzat – rabbi shimon poter. uvaavoda zara, afillu omer: "hayyom ivduha ulemachar batteluha" – divre hakkol chayyayv.
Abbaye savar la kerav chisda, umetaretz la kerav chisda. rava savar la kerav hamenuna, umetaretz la kerav hamenuna.

Abbaye savar la kerav chisda, umetaretz la kerav chisda: hammitnabbe laakor davar min hattora – divre hakkol bechenek. lekayyem miktzat ulevattel miktzat – rabbi shimon poter, vehu haddin lerabbanan. uvaavoda zara, afillu amar "hayyom ivduha ulemachar batteluha" – chayyayv. mar kidit leh, umar kidit leh.

Rava savar la kerav hamenuna, umetaretz la kerav hamenuna: hammitnabbe laakor davar min hattora, ben baavoda zara ben bishar mitzvot – chayyayv, mar kidit leh umar kidit leh. lekayyem miktzat ulevattel miktzat bishar mitzvot – rabbi shimon poter, vehu haddin lerabbanan. uvaavoda zara, afillu omer "hayyom ivduha ulemachar batteluha" – chayyayv, mar kidit leh umar kidit leh.

Amar rabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan: bakkol, im yomar lecha navi "avor al divre tora" – shema lo, chutz meavoda zara, sheafillu maamid lecha chamma beemtza harakia – al tishma lo. tanya, rabbi yose haggelili omer: higgia tora lesof datah shel avoda zara, lefichach natna tora memshala bah, sheafillu maamid lecha chamma beemtza harakia – al tishma lo.
Tanya, amar rabbi akiva: chas veshalom shehakkadosh baruch hu maamid chamma leovre retzono! ella kegon chananya ben azzur, shemmittechillato nevi emet, ulevassof nevi sheker.

Vezomme bat kohen – menahane mille? amar rav acha bereh derav ika: detanya, rabbi yose omer: ma talmud lomar "vaasitem lo kaasher zamam laasot leachiv"? lefi shekkol hamezummamin shebbattora, zommehen uvoalehen kayyotze bahen.
Bat kohen hi bisrefa, veen boalah bisrefa. zommin – eni yodea im lo hukeshu, im lah hukeshu. keshehu omer "laasot leachiv" – leachiv velo laachoto.
Hadaran alach ellu hen hannechnakin

Mishna kol yisrael yesh lahem chelek laolam habba, shenneemar: "veammech kullam tzaddikim leolam yirshu aretz netzer mattaay maase yaday lehitpaer". veellu sheen lahem chelek laolam habba: haomer en techiyyayt hammetim min hattora, veen tora min hashshamayim, veeppikoros.

Rabbi akiva omer: af hakkore bassefarim hachitzonim, vehallochesh al hammakka veomer "kol hammachala asher samti vemitzrayim lo asim alecha ki ani Adonai rofecha". abba shaul omer: af hahoge et hashshem beotiyyotav.

Shelosha melachim vearbaa hedyotot en lahen chelek laolam habba. shelosha melachim: yarovam, achav, umenashshe. rabbi yehuda omer: menashshe yesh lo chelek laolam habba, shenneemar "vayyitpallel elav vayyishma techinnato vayshivehu yerushalaym lemalchuto". amru lo: lemalchuto heshivo velo lechayye haolam habba heshivo. arbaa hedyotot: bilam, vedoeg, vaachitofel, vegechazi.
Gemara vechol kach lamma? tana: hu kafar bitchiyyayt hammetim, lefichach lo yihye lo chelek bitchiyyayt hammetim, shekkol middotav shel hakkadosh baruch hu midda keneged midda.

Deamar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan: minnayin shekkol middotav shel hakkadosh baruch hu midda keneged midda? shenneemar: "vayyomer elisha shimu devar Adonai [vegomer] kaet machar sea solet beshekel vesatayim seorim beshekel beshaar shomron". uchetiv: "vayyaan hashshalish asher hammelech nishan al yado et ish haelohim vayyomar hinne Adonai ose arubbot bashshamayim hayihye haddavar hazze vayyomer hinnecha roe beenecha umishsham lo tochel".
b: Uchetiv: "vayhi lo ken vayyirmesu oto haam bashshaar vayyamot". vedilma killat elisha gerama leh? deamar rav yehuda amar rav: killat chacham, afillu al chinnam hi baa. im ken, lichtov kera: "vayyirmesuhu vayyamot". may "bashshaar"? al iske shaar.

Amar rabbi yochanan: minnayin litchiyyayt hammetim min hattora? shenneemar: "unetattem mimmennu [et] terumat Adonai leaharon hakkohen". vechi aharon leolam kayyaym? vahalo lo nichnas leeretz yisrael shennotnin lo teruma! ella melammed sheatid lichyot, veyisrael notnin lo teruma. mikkan litchiyyayt hammetim min hattora.
Deve rabbi yishmael tana: "leaharon" – keaharon, ma aharon chaver – af banav chaverim.

Amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan: minnayin sheen notnin teruma lechohen am haaretz? shenneemar: "vayyomer laam leyoshve yerushalaym latet menat hakkohanim vehaleviyyim lemaan yechezku betorat Adonai". kol hammachzik betorat Adonai – yesh lo menat, vesheeno machzik betorat Adonai – en lo menat.

Amar rav acha bar adda amar rav yehuda: kol hannoten teruma lechohen am haaretz, keillu notnah lifne ari. ma ari - safek dores veochel, safek eno dores veochel, af kohen am haaretz - safek ochlah betohora, safek ochlah betumea.
Rabbi yochanan amar: af gorem lo mita, shenneemar "umetu vo ki yechalleluhu". deve rabbi eliezer ben yaakov tana: af massio avon ashma, shenneemar "vehissiu otam avon ashma beochlam et kodshehem".

Tanya, rabbi simay omer: minnayin litchiyyayt hammetim min hattora? shenneemar: "vegam hakimoti et beriti ittam latet lahem et eretz kenaan". "lachem" lo neemar, ella "lahem". mikkan litchiyyayt hammetim min hattora.
(Tzedek gam geshem kam siman) shaalu tzaddukim et rabban gamliel: minnayin shehakkadosh baruch hu mechayye metim? amar lahem: min hattora, umin hanneviim, umin hakketuvim. velo kibbelu mimmennu.
Min hattora, dichtiv: "vayyomer Adonai el moshe hinnecha shochev im avotecha vekam". amru lo: vedilma "vekam haam hazze vezana"?
Min hanneviim, dichtiv: "yichyu metecha nevelati yekumun hakitzu verannenu shochne afar ki tal orot tallecha vaaretz refaim tappil". vedilma metim shehechya yechezkel?

Min hakketuvim, dichtiv: "vechikkech keyen hattov holech ledodi lemesharim dovev sifte yeshenim". vedilma rachoshe merachashan sifvavteh bealma? kerabbi yochanan, deamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yehotzadak: kol mi shenneemra halacha bishmo beolam hazze, siftotav dovvot bakkever, shenneemar: "dovev sifte yeshenim".
Ad sheamar lahem mikra ze: "asher nishba Adonai laavotechem latet lahem". "lachem" lo neemar, ella "lahem". mikkan litchiyyayt hammetim min hattora.

Veyesh omrim: min hammikra hazze amar lahem, "veattem haddevekim baAdonai elohechem chayyim kullechem hayyom". peshita dechayyim kullechem hayyom! ella, afillu beyom shekkol haolam kullam metim – attem chayyim. ma hayyom kullechem kayyaymin, af laolam habba kullechem kayyaymin.

Shaalu romiyyim et rabbi yehoshua ben chananya: minnayin shehakkadosh baruch hu mechayye metim, veyodea ma sheatid lihyot? amar lehu: tarvavyyhu min hammikra hazze, shenneemar: "vayyomer Adonai el moshe hinnecha shochev im avotecha vekam haam hazze vezana".

Vedilma "vekam haam hazze vezana"? amar lehu: nekutu miha palga bidayychu, deyodea ma sheatid lihyot. ittemar name, amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay: minnayin shehakkadosh baruch hu mechayye metim veyodea ma sheatid lihyot? shenneemar "hinnecha shochev im avotecha vekam vegomer".

Tanya: amar rabbi eliezer berabbi yose: bedavar ze ziyyayfti sifre chutim, shehayu omrim en techiyyayt hammetim min hattora. amarti lahen: ziyyayftem toratchem velo heelitem beyedchem kelum, sheattem omrim en techiyyayt hammetim min hattora. hare hu omer "hikkaret tikkaret hannefesh hahi avonah bah". "hikkaret tikkaret" – baolam hazze, "avonah bah" – leemat? lav laolam habba?
Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye: velema lehu tarvayyhu mehikkaret tikkaret"! inhu havo amri leh: dibbera tora kilshon bene adam.

Ketannae: "hikkaret tikkaret" – "hikkaret" baolam hazze, "tikkaret" laolam habba, divre rabbi akiva. amar lo rabbi yishmael: vahalo kevar neemar "et Adonai hu megaddef venichreta", vechi shelosha olamim yesh? ella "venichreta" baolam hazze, "hikkaret" laolam habba, "hikkaret tikkaret" – dibbera tora chilshon bene adam.
Ben rabbi yishmael uven rabbi akiva, "avonah bah" may avdi beh? lechidtanya: yachol afillu asa teshuva? talmud lomar: "avonah bah". lo amarti ella bizman sheavonah bah.

Shaala keleoppatra malketa et rabbi meir. amra: yadana dechayi shachve, dichtiv "veyatzitzu meir keesev haaretz". ella keshehen omdin, omdin arumin o bilvushehen omdin? amar la: kal vachomer mechitta. uma chitta shennikbera arumma yotza bechamma levushin, tzaddikim shennikbarim bilvushehen – al achat kamma vechamma.
Amar leh kesar lerabban gamliel: amritu deshachve chayi. ha havu afra, veafra mi ka chaye?!

a: Amara leh beratte: shivkeh, vaana mahdarna leh. shene yotzrim yesh beirenu: echad yotzer min hammayim, veechad yotzer min hattit. eze mehen meshubbach? amar lah: ze sheyyotzer min hammayim. amra lo: min hammayim tzar, min hattit lo kol shekken?

Deve rabbi yishmael tana: kal vachomer mikkele zechuchit, ma kele zechuchit sheamalan beruach basar vadam - nishberu yesh lahen takkana, basar vadam shebberucho shel hakkadosh baruch hu – al achat kamma vechamma.

Amar leh hahu mina lerabbi amme: amritu deshachve chayi. veha havu afra, veafra mi ka chaye?! amar leh: emshol lecha mashal. lema haddavar dome? lemelech basar vadam sheamar laavadav: lechu uvenu li palterin gedolim bimkom sheen mayim veafar. halchu uvanu otan. leyamim naflu. amar lahem: chizru uvenu otan bimkom sheyyesh afar vamayim. amru lo: en anu yecholin.

Kaas alehem, veamar lahen: bimkom sheen mayim veafar benitem, achshav sheyyesh mayim veafar – al achat kamma vechamma! veim i atta maamin, tze labbika uree achbar shehayyom chetzyo basar vechetzyo adama, lemachar hishritz venaasa kullo basar. shemma tomar lizman merubbe? ale lahar uree shehayyom en bo ella chillazon echad, lemachar yardu geshamim venitmalle kullo chelzonot.

Amar leh hahu mina ligviha ben pesisa: vavy lechon chayyayvayya, deamritun mite chayin! dechayin mayti, demite chayin? amar leh: vavy lechon chayyayvayya, deamritun mite la chayin! dela havo chayi, dahavo chayye – lo kol shekken? amar leh: chayyayvayya karet li? i kaemna, baetna bach ufashetna leakmutach minnach! amar leh: im atta ose ken, rofe umman tikkare, vesachar harebe tittol.

Tanu rabbanan: beesrim vearbaa benisan itnetilu demosnae mihuda umirushalayim. keshebbau bene afrikiyya ladun im yisrael lifne alekkesanderos mokdon, amru lo: eretz kenaan shellanu hi, dichtiv "eretz kenaan ligvuloteha", uchenaan avuhon dehanhu inashe hava.

Amar lehu geviha ben pesisa lachachamim: tenu li reshut veelech veadun immahen lifne alekkesanderos mokdon. im yenatztzechuni, imru: hedyot shebbanu nitztzachtem, veim ani anatztzeach otam, imru lahem: torat moshe nitztzechatchem. natnu lo reshut, vehalach vedan immahem.

Amar lahem: mehechan attem meviim reayay? amru lo: min hattora. amar lahen: af ani lo avi lachem reayay ella min hattora, shenneemar: "vayyomer arur kenaan eved avadim yihye leechav". eved shekkana nechasim – eved lemi unechasim lemi? velo od, ella shehare kamma shanim shello avadtunu!

Amar lahem alekkesanderos malka: hacheziru lo teshuva! amru lo: tenu lanu zeman shelosha yamim. natan lahem zeman. badku velo matzu teshuva. miyyad barchu, vehinnichu sedotehen keshehen zeruot, vecharmehen keshehen netuot. veotah shana sheviit hayta.

Shuv paam achat bau bene mitzrayim ladun im yisrael lifne alekkesanderos mokdon. amru lo: hare hu omer "vaAdonai natan et chen haam beene mitzrayim vayyashilum". tenu lanu kesef vezahav shennetaltem mimmennu.

Amar geviha ben pesisa lachachamim: tenu li reshut veelech veadun immahen lifne alekkesanderos. im yenatztzechuni, imru lahem: hedyot shebbanu nitztzachtem, veim ani anatztzeach otam, imru lahem: torat moshe rabbenu nitztzechatchem. natnu lo reshut vehalach vedan immahen.

Amar lahen: mehechan attem meviin reayay? amru lo: min hattora. amar lahen: af ani lo avi lachem reayay ella min hattora, shenneemar: "umoshav bene yisrael asher yashvu bemitzrayim sheloshim shana vearba meot shana". tenu lanu sechar avoda shel shishshim ribbo sheshshibadtem bemitzrayim sheloshim shana vearba meot shana.

Amar lahen alekkesanderos mokdon: hacheziru lo teshuva! amru lo: tenu lanu zeman shelosha yamim. natan lahem zeman. badku velo matzu teshuva. miyyad hinnichu sedotehen keshehen zeruot, vecharmehen keshehen netuot, uvarchu. veotah shana sheviit hayta.

Veshuv paam achat bau bene yishmael uvene ketura ladun im yisrael lifne alekkesanderos mokdon. amru lo: eretz kenaan shellanu veshellachem, dichtiv "veelle toldot yishmael ben avraham" uchetiv "elle toldot yitzchak ben avraham".

Amar lahen geviha ben pesisa lachachamim: tenu li reshut veelech veadun immahem lifne alekkesanderos mokdon. im yenatztzechuni imru: hedyot shebbanu nitztzachtem, veim ani anatztzeach otam imru lahem: torat moshe rabbenu nitztzechatchem. natnu lo reshut, halach vedan immahen.

Amar lahem: mehechan attem meviin reayay? amru lo: min hattora. amar lahen: af ani lo avi reayay ella min hattora, shenneemar: "vayyitten avraham et kol asher lo leyitzchak. velivne happilagshim asher leavraham natan avraham mattanot". av shennatan agittin levanav bechayyav veshigger ze meal ze, kelum yesh laze al ze kelum? may mattanot? amar rabbi yirmeya bar abba: melammed shemmasar lahem shem tumea.

Amar leh antoninus lerabbi: guf uneshama yecholin liftor atzman min haddin. ketzad? guf omer: neshama chatat, shemmiyyom sheppersha mimmenni hareni muttal keeven dumam bakkever. uneshama omeret: guf chata, shemmiyyom shepperashti mimmennu hareni porachat baavir ketzippor. amar leh: emshol lecha mashal. lema haddavar dome? lemelech basar vadam shehaya lo pardes nae, vehaya bo
b: Bakkurot naot, vehoshiv bo shene shomrim: echad chigger veechad some. amar lo chigger lassome: bakkurot naot ani roe bappardes. bo veharekiveni uneviem leochlam. rachav chigger al gabbe some, vehevium vaachalum.

Leyamim ba baal pardes. amar lahen: bakkurot naot hechan hen? amar lo chigger: kelum yesh li raglayim lehallech bahen? amar lo some: kelum yesh li enayim lirot? ma asa? hirkiv chigger al gabbe some, vedan otam keechad.

Af hakkadosh baruch hu mevi neshama vezorkah bagguf, vedan otam keechad, shenneemar: "yikra el hashshamayim meal veel haaretz ladin ammo". "yikra el hashshamayim meal" – zo neshama, "veel haaretz ladin ammo" – ze hagguf.
Amar leh antoninus lerabbi: mippene ma chamma yotza bammizrach veshokaat bemaarav? amar leh: i hava ippecha name hachi hava amrat li. amar leh, hachi kaamena lach: mippene ma shokaat bammaarav?
Amar leh: kede litten shalom lekonah, shenneemar "utzeva hashshamayim lecha mishtachavim". amar leh: vetete ad palga derakia, vetitten shelama, veteol! mishshum poalim umishshum ovre derachim.

Veamar lo antoninus lerabbi: neshama meematay nittena baadam, mishsheat pekida o mishsheat yetzira? amar lo: mishsheat yetzira. amar lo: efshar chaticha shel basar omedet shelosha yamim belo melach veenah masrachat? ella mishsheat pekida. amar rabbi: davar ze limmedani antoninus, umikra mesayyeyo shenneemar "ufekuddatcha shamra ruchi".

Veamar lo antoninus lerabbi: meematay yetzer hara sholet baadam, mishsheat yetzira o mishsheat yetzia? amar lo: mishsheat yetzira. amar lo: im ken, boet bime immo veyotze! ella mishsheat yetzia. amar rabbi: davar ze limmedani antoninus, umikra mesayyeyo, shenneemar: "lappetach chattat rovetz".

Resh lakish rame: ketiv "bam ivver ufisseach hara veyoledet yachdav", uchetiv "az yedalleg kaayyal pisseach vetaron leshon illem ki nivkeu vammidbar mayim unechalim baarava". ha ketzad? omdin bemuman umitrappein.

Ulla rame: ketiv "billa hammavet lanetzach umacha Adonai dima meal kol panim", uchetiv "ki hannaar ben mea shana yamut lo yihye mishsham od ul yamim". la kashya: kan – beyisrael, kan – beummot haolam. veummot haolam may bau hatam? hanach dichtiv behu "veamdu zarim verau tzonchem uvene nechar ikkarechem vechormechem".

Rav chisda rame: ketiv "vechafra hallevana uvosha hachamma ki malach Adonai tzevaot", uchetiv "vehaya or hallevana keor hachamma veor hachamma yihye shivatayim keor shivat hayyamim". la kashya: kan limot hammashiach, kan laolam habba.
Velishmuel, deamar: en ben haolam hazze limot hammashiach ella shibud galiyyot bilvad, la kashya: kan bemachane tzaddikim, kan bemachane shechina.
Rava rame: ketiv "ani amit vaachayye", uchetiv "machatzti vaani erpa". amar hakkadosh baruch hu: ma sheani memit – ani mechayye, vahadar ma shemmachatzti – vaani erpa.

Tanu rabbanan: "ani amit vaachayye" – yachol shettehe mita beechad vechayyim beechad, kederech shehaolam noheg? talmud lomar: "machatzti vaani erpa" – ma mechitza urefua beechad, af mita vechayyim beechad. mikkan teshuva laomrin en techiyyayt hammetim min hattora.

Tanya, amar rabbi meir: minnayin litchiyyayt hammetim min hattora? shenneemar: "az yashir moshe uvene yisrael et hashshira hazzot laAdonai". "shar" lo neemar, ella "yashir" – mikkan litchiyyayt hammetim min hattora. kayyotze baddavar, atta omer: "az yivne yehoshua mizbeach laAdonai". "bana" lo neemar, ella "yivne" – mikkan litchiyyayt hammetim min hattora.
Ella meatta, "az yivne shelomo bama lichmosh shikkutz moav", hachi name deyivne? ella maale alav hakkatuv keillu bana.

Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: minnayin litchiyyayt hammetim min hattora? shenneemar: "ashre yoshve vetecha od yehallucha sela". "hilleluch" lo neemar, ella "yehallucha" – mikkan litchiyyayt hammetim min hattora. veamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: kol haomer shira beolam hazze zoche veomrah laolam habba, shenneemar: "ashre yoshve vetecha od yehallucha sela".

Amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: minnayin litchiyyayt hammetim min hattora? shenneemar: "kol tzofayich nasu kol yachdav yerannenu vego". "rinnenu" lo neemar, ella "yerannenu" – mikkan litchiyyayt hammetim min hattora. veamar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: atidin kol hanneviim kullan omrim shira bekol echad, shenneemar: "kol tzofayich nasu kol yachdav yerannenu".

Amar rav yehuda amar rav: kol hammonea halacha mippi talmid, keillu gozlo minnachalat avotav, shenneemar: "tora tzivva lanu moshe morasha kehillat yaakov". morasha hi lechol yisrael mishsheshet yeme bereshit. amar rav chana bar bizna amar rabbi shimon chasida: kol hammonea halacha mippi talmid, afillu ubbarin shebbime imman mekallelin oto, shenneemar: "monea bar
